原文: It can be generally understood that English has evolved into the representative international common language, i.e. lingua franca. When browsing the internet, people can find many English sites. According to an estimation made by W3Techs in 2022 $^{[6]}$ , English is used by 60,4 % of all the websites whose content language is known. ASD-STE100 $^{[3]}$ , one of the representative controlled English rule sets, has been downloaded by 71 % non-English-native-speaking countries compared with 29 % English-speaking countries $^{[4]}$ . This is natural considering communication methods with other countries. Currently, people generally communicate with other people in non-English speaking countries by using English via the internet, email and social media. Therefore, it is necessary to make the communication tool (i.e. English) more understandable and translatable. This document provides guidelines for non-native English speakers to write English in an easy-to-understand manner, not just native English speakers.
译文: 普遍认为，英语已经发展为具有代表性的国际通用语，即跨语言交际通用语（lingua franca）。浏览互联网时，可以看到大量英语网站。W3Techs于2022年的估算[6]显示，在内容语言已知的网站中，60.4%使用英语。作为受控英语规则集的代表之一，ASD-STE100[3]的下载量中，来自非英语母语国家的占71%，来自英语国家的占29%[4]。考虑到跨国沟通的方式，这种情况并不意外。目前，人们通常通过互联网、电子邮件和社交媒体，使用英语与非英语国家的人沟通。因此，有必要使这一沟通工具——英语——更容易理解和翻译。本文件提供的指南旨在帮助英语非母语者用易懂的英语写作，也适用于英语母语者。

原文: In addition, in some countries, there is an active movement to improve the language itself so that it can be communicated in an easy-to-understand and non-misunderstood manner in order to promote communication. Typical examples are plain languages $^{[5]}$ and ASD-STE100 $^{[3]}$ . Both have a long history, especially ASD-STE100 $^{[3]}$ , which was first released in 1983. In addition, plain languages have evolved into the languages of various countries, not just English. In the future, it could be helpful to have writing rules that cover both plain languages and ASD-STE100 $^{[3]}$ across the board.
译文: 此外，一些国家正在积极推动改进语言表达，使沟通内容易于理解、不易引起误解。典型例子有简明语言[5]和ASD-STE100[3]。二者均有较长历史，尤其是ASD-STE100[3]，其首次发布于1983年。此外，简明语言的应用已扩展到多个国家的语言，并不限于英语。今后，制定能够同时涵盖简明语言与ASD-STE100[3]的通用写作规则，可能会有所帮助。

原文: It is possible that the writing rules of this document overlap with the rules of plain languages and controlled languages (such as ASD-STE100 $^{[3]}$ ), but it also includes other detailed rules. This is to be able to address various languages in detail. The writing rules are not based solely on one language, as is the traditional practice, but instead by comparing English with a linguistically different language such as Japanese.
译文: 本文件的写作规则可能与简明语言及受控语言（如ASD-STE100[3]）的规则有所重合，但也包含其他更细致的规则，以便具体处理不同语言的情况。与传统做法不同，这些写作规则并非只以一种语言为基础，而是通过比较英语与日语等在语言特点上不同于英语的语言而形成。

原文: Writing using this document can facilitate communication around the world by writing original text that is easy for the readers to understand and by improving the quality of machine-translated output text.
译文: 使用本文件进行写作，可以使原文更容易为读者理解，并提高机器翻译输出文本的质量，从而促进全球沟通。

原文: Basic principles and methodology for stylistic guidelines (BSG)
译文: 文体指南的基本原则与方法（BSG）

原文: This document establishes a set of basic writing rules, called “basic principles and methodology for stylistic guidelines (BSG)”, for writing in English that can be applied to other languages, facilitating communication in each language and from a language to other languages. It includes conceptual writing rules as well as specific grammar ones.
译文: 本文件确立一组基本写作规则，称为“文体指南的基本原则与方法（BSG）”。这些规则用于英语写作，也可应用于其他语言，以促进使用同一种语言的人之间的沟通，以及不同语言之间的沟通。规则既包括写作理念方面的规则，也包括具体的语法规则。

原文: This document is designed to facilitate written communication in English for native and non-native English speakers. It allows English native and non-English native speakers to smoothly communicate through social media or email using English, or to translate into their local language. Furthermore, this document is applicable to the languages of each community. In other words, it aims to promote bidirectional communication between two particular languages.
译文: 本文件旨在帮助英语母语者和非母语者开展英语书面沟通。它使双方能够通过社交媒体或电子邮件，顺畅地用英语沟通，或将内容译成本地语言。此外，本文件也适用于各语言社群的语言。换言之，其目的是促进两种特定语言之间的双向沟通。

原文: There are no normative references in this document.
译文: 本文件没有规范性引用文件。

## 3.2

## technical communication

process of defining and creating information for use to be delivered as information products for the safe, effective, and efficient use of a supported product throughout its life cycle

## 3.3

## plain language

communication in which wording, structure and design are so clear that the intended readers can easily 

— find what they need, 

understand what they find, and 

— use that information 

[SOURCE: ISO 24495-1:2023, 3.1]

原文:
## 3.4

原文:
## 3.7

## internationalization

process of generalizing a product so that it can handle multiple languages and cultural conventions without the need for re-design 

Note 1 to entry: Internationalization takes place at the level of programme design and document development. 

[SOURCE: Localization Industry Standards Association (LISA) $^{[7]}$ ]

原文:
## 3.8

## localization

process of taking a product and making it linguistically and culturally appropriate to the target locale (country/region and language) where it will be used and sold

原文: Since there are many common factors and rules among languages, it is possible to create a set of writing rules that is applicable to many different languages.
译文: 不同语言之间有许多共同要素和规则，因此可以制定一组适用于多种不同语言的写作规则。

原文: 5 Methodology — How to apply the rules
译文: 5 方法——如何应用这些规则

原文: The task of simplifying language can be divided into two groups: sentences and words. Sentences are involved in syntactic and grammatical issues, which can be applicable to all languages. On the other hand, since words (or vocabulary) heavily depend on the language of each country, it is difficult to find and apply common rules.
译文: 简化语言的工作可分为两个方面：句子和词。句子层面涉及句法和语法问题，对这些问题的处理可适用于各种语言。另一方面，词或词汇高度依赖各国的具体语言，因此难以找到并应用共同规则。

原文: The BSG given in this document concentrate on simplifying language by sentences, including clauses and phrases. Any difficulties related to writing sentences can be solved by applying the 3C rules in technical writing and technical communication: clear, correct and concise:
译文: 本文件的BSG着重从句子层面（包括分句和短语）简化语言。运用技术写作和技术传播中的3C原则——清楚（clear）、正确（correct）、简练（concise），可以解决句子写作方面的各种困难：

原文: — clearly showing the sentence structure and not making the structure complicated;
译文: — 清楚地展示句子结构，不使结构复杂化；

原文: — writing in statements of fact, and distinguishing between facts and opinions;
译文: — 用陈述事实的方式写作，并区分事实与意见；

原文: — giving simple and concise expressions.
译文: — 采用简单、简练的表达。

原文: The 3C rules are applicable to any language, and are used in many writing guidelines for plain languages and controlled languages.
译文: 3C原则适用于任何语言，并已用于许多简明语言和受控语言写作指南。

原文: BSG in one language can be created immediately by applying this English version to that language. Some grammatical or syntactic ingenuity can be required.
译文: 将本英语版本应用于某种语言，即可据此制定该语言的BSG。过程中可能需要针对语法或句法作一些巧妙调整。

原文: Figure 1 — Terms used in globalization
译文: 图1——全球化中使用的术语

原文: Based on the BSG rules (in English), create language rules corresponding to each of the English rules. To do this, an idea of internationalization is necessary to find similarities in languages to make them more generalized, rather than finding differences.
译文: 以英语BSG规则为基础，为每一条英语规则制定相应的目标语言规则。为此，需要采用国际化的思路，寻找语言间的共同点，使规则更具通用性，而不是寻找差异。

原文: After internationalization, the production stage moves to the language-specific matters: localization. A dictionary specific to the language selected, including the approved words and deprecated words, can be necessary ("vocabulary control"). The dictionary should be created for each language to make effective use of this rule set. However, creating a dictionary is not mandatory. If it is too time-consuming to create a dictionary, starting with just the writing rules is possible.
译文: 国际化之后，制作过程转向具体语言的问题，即本地化。此时可能需要为所选语言编制专用词典，列出准用词和不推荐用词，以实施“词汇控制”。宜为每种语言分别编制词典，从而有效使用本规则集。但编制词典不是强制要求。如果耗时过多，也可以先从写作规则做起。

原文: No: For an instructional information, an active voice sentence clearly tells who should carry out the action. To make a precaution message effective, you should show the consequences of the potential risks to the user. The passive voice focuses on the result since the object in an active voice sentence is dealt as the subject. On the contrary, the active voice lets the reader to follow the instructions. If an imperative sentence is used for an instruction, an English native speaker feels more directly addressed.
译文: 不推荐写法：对于操作指令类信息，主动语态句可以清楚地说明应由谁执行动作。要使注意事项提示有效，您宜向用户说明潜在风险造成的后果。被动语态侧重于结果，因为主动语态句中的宾语在被动语态中被用作主语。相反，主动语态让读者得以遵循指令。如果操作指令使用祈使句，英语母语者会觉得指令是在更直接地对自己说的。

原文: Yes: Syntax-checking mode is in effect only during the step in which the program encountered the error.
译文: 推荐写法：语法检查模式仅在程序遇到错误的那个步骤期间生效。

原文: 7.5.2 BSG Rule 4.2: Do not put a long modifying phrase between the noun and verb.
译文: 7.5.2 BSG规则4.2：不要在名词与动词之间放置过长的修饰短语。

原文: No: The cat, which is on top of an orange wall, walks.
译文: 不推荐写法：那只猫在一堵橙色墙的顶上，正在走动。

原文: Yes: The cat walks on top of an orange wall.
译文: 推荐写法：那只猫在一堵橙色墙的顶上走着。

原文: No: The institute cannot, though it tries to figure out the problem, find an appropriate solution.
译文: 不推荐写法：该研究所无法找到恰当的解决办法，尽管它努力弄清这个问题。

原文: Yes: Although the institute tries to figure out the problem, it cannot find an appropriate solution.
译文: 推荐写法：尽管该研究所努力弄清这个问题，它仍无法找到恰当的解决办法。

原文: 7.5.3 BSG Rule 4.3: Break an overlong subject phrase to make concise sentences.
译文: 7.5.3 BSG规则4.3：拆分过长的主语短语，使句子简洁。

原文: No: The rest of the existing documents such as brochures, catalogues, training materials, service manuals, owner's manuals and specifications are further important resources.
译文: 不推荐写法：其余现有文件，例如宣传册、产品目录、培训资料、维修手册、用户手册和规格说明书，也都是重要资源。

原文: Yes: The rest of the existing documents are further important resources. They are brochures, catalogues, training materials, service manuals, owner's manuals and specifications.
译文: 推荐写法：其余现有文件也都是重要资源。这些文件是宣传册、产品目录、培训资料、维修手册、用户手册和规格说明书。

原文: 7.5.4 BSG Rule 4.4: Clarify a modification by changing the word order.
译文: 7.5.4 BSG规则4.4：通过改变词序，使修饰关系明确。

原文: No: The improvement for the chemical treatment he proposed has been approved by the board.
译文: 不推荐写法：他提出的化学处理的改进方案已获董事会批准。

原文: Yes: The improvement he proposed for the chemical treatment has been approved by the board.
译文: 推荐写法：他针对化学处理提出的改进方案已获董事会批准。

原文: 7.5.5 BSG Rule 4.5: If necessary, repeat the modifier.
译文: 7.5.5 BSG规则4.5：必要时，重复修饰语。

原文: No: The stored query is executed when you use the view in the functional SUS procedure or subroutine.
译文: 不推荐写法：当您在功能性SUS过程或子程序中使用该视图时，就会执行已存储的查询。

原文: Yes: The stored query is executed when you use the view in the functional SUS procedure or the functional subroutine.
译文: 推荐写法：当您在功能性SUS过程或功能性子程序中使用该视图时，就会执行已存储的查询。

原文: 7.5.6 BSG Rule 4.6: Remove a complementary description enclosed by the parentheses in a sentence. Move the description just after the sentence or paraphrase the sentence.
译文: 7.5.6 BSG规则4.6：将句中括号内的补充说明移出该句。将该说明紧接在该句之后另行写出，或改写该句。

原文: No: The Arrange item aligns the icons for the data objects (in multiple rows, if needed).
译文: 不推荐写法：排列（Arrange）项会对齐数据对象的图标（如有需要，可排成多行）。

原文: Yes: The Arrange item aligns the icons for the data objects. The icons can be arranged in multiple rows.
译文: 推荐写法：排列（Arrange）项会对齐数据对象的图标。图标可以排成多行。

原文: 7.6 Vocabulary
译文: 7.6 词汇

原文: 7.6.1 BSG Rule 5.1: Use specific words. Do not use equivocal words.
译文: 7.6.1 BSG规则5.1：使用含义明确的词。不要使用含义不确定的词。

原文: Especially, do not use phrasal verbs (see Note below) that can have several different meanings. For example, "come out" has 18 different meanings.
译文: 尤其不要使用可能具有多种不同含义的短语动词（见下方注）。例如，“come out”有18种不同的含义。

原文: No: Negative numbers stand for the bottom n values.
译文: 不推荐写法：负数表示最下面的n个值。

原文: Yes: Negative numbers represent the bottom n values.
译文: 推荐写法：负数表示最下面的n个值。

原文: No: This compound can give off poisonous fumes.
译文: 不推荐写法：这种化合物可能释放有毒烟气。

原文: Yes: This compound can release poisonous fumes.
译文: 推荐写法：这种化合物可能释放有毒烟气。

原文: NOTE Phrasal verbs can make it difficult for non-English speakers to immediately understand the meaning. For example:
译文: 注：短语动词可能使非英语使用者难以立即理解其含义。例如：

原文: call off → cancel
译文: 取消（call off）→取消（cancel）

原文: back out → withdraw
译文: 退出（back out）→退出（withdraw）

原文: turn down → refuse
译文: 拒绝（turn down）→拒绝（refuse）

原文: rule out $\rightarrow$ exclude
译文: 排除（rule out）→排除（exclude）

原文: put off → postpone
译文: 推迟（put off）→推迟（postpone）

原文: (be) cheesed off with $\rightarrow$ (be) fed up with = weary or tired
译文: （对……）感到厌烦（(be) cheesed off with）→（对……）感到厌烦（(be) fed up with）＝厌倦或疲倦（weary or tired）

原文: Use specific words to explain a thing or a matter precisely, without using equivocal or ambiguous words. Specific words and familiar words sometimes conflict with each other; the more specific, the more it becomes difficult, and the more familiar, the more its meaning becomes ambiguous. See 7.6.2 for more information.
译文: 应使用含义明确的词准确说明某个事物或事项，不要使用含义不确定或有歧义的词。使用含义明确的词与使用人们熟悉的词这两项要求有时会相互冲突：词义越明确，词就越难懂；词越熟悉，词义就越含糊。更多信息见7.6.2。

原文: Do not use long words or big words.
译文: 不要使用长词或艰深的大词。

原文: 7.6.3 BSG Rule 5.3: If there are two different words with the same spelling, replace one of them to differentiate the meaning (orthography).
译文: 7.6.3 BSG规则5.3：如果两个不同的词拼写相同，应替换其中一个，以区分含义（正字法）。

原文: Yes: She went to the bank on the river's edge.
译文: 推荐写法：她去了河边的银行。

原文: 7.6.4 BSG Rule 5.4: Use concrete and plain expressions for difficult technical terms and abbreviations (acronyms).
译文: 7.6.4 BSG规则5.4：对于难懂的技术术语和缩略语（首字母缩略词），使用具体、浅白的表达。

原文: No: The dossier contains each of the following:
译文: 不推荐写法：档案材料包含以下各项：

原文: Yes: The report contains each of the following:
译文: 推荐写法：报告包含以下各项：

原文: No: According to the research laboratory, it is called melatonin a.k.a. "sleep hormone."
译文: 不推荐写法：据该研究实验室介绍，它被称为褪黑素，又名（a.k.a.）“睡眠激素”。

原文: Yes: According to the research laboratory, it is called melatonin also known as "sleep hormone."
译文: 推荐写法：据该研究实验室介绍，它被称为褪黑素，又名（also known as）“睡眠激素”。

原文: 7.6.5 BSG Rule 5.5: Do not use a compound word consisting of more than four words.
译文: 7.6.5 BSG规则5.5：不要使用由超过四个词组成的复合词。

原文: 7.6.6 BSG Rule 5.6: Paraphrase polysemic words (homographs) to clarify the meaning.
译文: 7.6.6 BSG规则5.6：将多义词（同形异义词）换一种说法，以明确含义。

原文: 7.6.7 BSG Rule 5.7: Omit unnecessary words (pruning).
译文: 7.6.7 BSG规则5.7：省去不必要的词（删赘）。

原文: No: The following memo summarizes the points briefly.
译文: 不推荐写法：以下备忘录简短地概述了各要点。

原文: Yes: The following memo summarizes the points.
译文: 推荐写法：以下备忘录概述了各要点。

原文: 7.6.8 BSG Rule 5.8: Keep the same term consistently for a specific idea: keyword (nouns and verbs).
译文: 7.6.8 BSG规则5.8：对于某一特定概念，始终使用同一术语，即关键词（名词和动词）。

原文: No: Check the screen of your monitor while another display shows the product from the opposite side.
译文: 不推荐写法：查看你的监视器的屏幕，同时另一台显示器显示该产品从相反一侧看去的图像。

原文: Yes: Check your monitor while another monitor shows the product from the opposite side.
译文: 推荐写法：查看你的监视器，同时另一台监视器显示该产品从相反一侧看去的图像。

原文: Keywords such as nouns (subjects) and verbs determine the original meaning of a sentence. Other parts of speech are adjectives and adverbs that modify nouns and verbs, and can be function words such as prepositions.
译文: 名词（主语）和动词等关键词决定句子的原本含义。其他词类包括修饰名词和动词的形容词、副词，也可以是介词等功能词。

原文: Yes: He hurried to the baggage claim and frustratingly waited for his baggage while the other passengers were already picking up theirs.
译文: 推荐写法：他匆忙赶到行李提取处，焦躁地等着自己的行李，而其他旅客已经在领取各自的行李了。

原文: In the "No" sentence in the Example, the verb "airdash" is an English word. The sentence also includes a buzzword, "baggravation", that is difficult to understand.
译文: 在本示例的“不推荐写法”中，动词“airdash”是一个英语词。该句还含有一个难以理解的流行词“baggravation”。

原文: 7.6.10 BSG Rule 5.10: Always be aware of the conceptual differences between English and the own language. If necessary, add an English translation.
译文: 7.6.10 BSG规则5.10：始终注意英语与本族语之间的概念差异。如有必要，添加英语译文。

原文: Yes: Clean and crisp image.
译文: 推荐写法：清新、明快的形象。

原文: No: Click the icon in the left top side of the display.
译文: 不推荐写法：单击显示器左上侧的图标。

原文: Yes: Click the icon in the top left-hand side of the display.
译文: 推荐写法：单击显示器左上侧的图标。

原文: 7.6.11 BSG Rule 5.11: Do not use onomatopoeia specific to a language or a group.
译文: 7.6.11 BSG规则5.11：不要使用某种语言或某个群体特有的拟声词。

原文: Yes: There was a flash of lightning in the western sky.
译文: 推荐写法：西边的天空中闪过一道闪电。

原文: Yes: Let's close the matter.
译文: 推荐写法：我们把这件事了结吧。

原文: 7.6.12 BSG Rule 5.12: Paraphrase the expressions unique to the own language (affected by language metaphors). Internationalize all expressions.
译文: 7.6.12 BSG规则5.12：将本族语特有的表达（受语言隐喻影响的表达）换一种说法。使所有表达国际化。

原文: No: Draw a circle with the size of 1 Euro coin.
译文: 不推荐写法：画一个与1欧元硬币大小相同的圆。

原文: Yes: Draw a circle with the diameter of 23,25 mm.
译文: 推荐写法：画一个直径为23.25 mm的圆。

原文: 7.7.1.1 BSG Rule 7.1: Write sentences logically, plainly and accurately.
译文: 7.7.1.1 BSG规则7.1：写句子时，做到逻辑清楚、表达浅白、内容准确。

原文: A leap in a logical expression can confuse the reader who then cannot easily read through the document. It is important to follow the Gricean maxims $^{[10]}$ of quality, quantity, relation and manner.
译文: 逻辑表述中的跳跃会使读者困惑，进而难以顺畅读完整份文档。遵循格赖斯的质、量、关系和方式准则[10]十分重要。

原文: 7.7.1.2 BSG Rule 7.2: Obey grammar and syntax rules.
译文: 7.7.1.2 BSG规则7.2：遵守语法和句法规则。

原文: Needless to say, this is the basic rule in communication.
译文: 毋庸赘言，这是沟通的基本规则。

原文: Yes: He likes the actor more than he likes me.
译文: 推荐写法：他对那位演员的喜欢，胜过对我的喜欢。

原文: He likes the actor more than I do.
译文: 他比我更喜欢那位演员。

原文: 7.7.1.3 BSG Rule 7.3: Differentiate affirmative and negative sentences.
译文: 7.7.1.3 BSG规则7.3：区分肯定句和否定句。

原文: Use affirmative sentences in procedural writing and descriptive writing (in main text).
译文: 在步骤性写作和描述性写作中（正文中）使用肯定句。

原文: Use negative sentences to get attention from the reader in warnings and cautions.
译文: 在警告和注意事项中使用否定句，以引起读者注意。

原文: 7.7.1.4 BSG Rule 7.4: Write positively (do not use double negatives).
译文: 7.7.1.4 BSG规则7.4：用肯定方式表述（不要使用双重否定）。

原文: Write as positively as possible. Negative sentences, especially “double negatives”, can lead to confusion or put an unnecessary burden onto the readers’ mind because they have to replace one of the negative expressions with a positive one to understand the meaning. However, negative expressions can be useful to attract the attention of readers and show a potential risk in warnings.
译文: 尽可能用肯定方式表述。否定句，特别是“双重否定”句，可能使读者困惑，或给读者带来不必要的心理负担，因为读者必须把其中一个否定表达转换为肯定表达，才能理解句意。不过，否定表达可用于在警告中引起读者注意，并指出潜在风险。

原文: Compare the following three sentences:
译文: 比较以下三个句子：

原文: — “I Can’t Get No Satisfaction” (Rolling Stones): putting an emphasis on “No”;
译文: ——“我怎么也得不到满足”（“I Can’t Get No Satisfaction”，滚石乐队）：强调“No”；

原文: No: You can't win the lottery if you don't buy a ticket.
译文: 不推荐写法：不买彩票，就不可能中奖。

原文: Yes: You have a chance to win the lottery if you buy a ticket.
译文: 推荐写法：买了彩票，你就有机会中奖。

原文: In this Example, the negative sentence is more motivating for customers.
译文: 在本示例中，否定句更能激发顾客的行动意愿。

原文: 7.7.1.5 BSG Rule 7.5: Be aware of the ambiguity of a partial negation.
译文: 7.7.1.5 BSG规则7.5：注意部分否定的歧义。

原文: In these cases, the sentence can mislead the readers. In particular, consider the position of the negation (no/not).
译文: 在这些情况下，句子可能误导读者。尤其要考虑否定词（no／not）的位置。

原文: Yes: Not all the people are satisfied with the result.
译文: 推荐写法：并非所有人都满意这个结果。

原文: No: That application is not found on all machines.
译文: 不推荐写法：那款应用程序并非在所有机器上都能找到。

原文: Yes: That application is not always found on all machines.
译文: 推荐写法：那款应用程序并不总能在所有机器上找到。

原文: Depending on the machines, that application is not available.
译文: 那款应用程序在有的机器上不可用。

原文: No: I do not know all of the employees of that company.
译文: 不推荐写法：我并不认识那家公司的所有员工。

原文: Yes: I know some of the employees of that company.
译文: 推荐写法：我认识那家公司的一些员工。

原文: 7.7.1.6 BSG Rule 7.6: Do not use unnecessary signs or symbols.
译文: 7.7.1.6 BSG规则7.6：不要使用不必要的记号或符号。

原文: If unnecessary signs or symbols specific to the language are used in documents, they can become corrupted during the translation process and cause problems. In addition, they make it difficult for screen readers to recognize characters and therefore prevent people with visually impairments from being able to access the document.
译文: 如果文档使用了某种语言特有且不必要的记号或符号，这些记号或符号可能在翻译过程中损坏，从而引发问题。此外，它们会使屏幕阅读器难以识别字符，因而使视力障碍人士无法访问文档。

原文: 7.7.1.7 BSG Rule 7.7: Keep consistencies with writing style including tone.
译文: 7.7.1.7 BSG规则7.7：保持行文风格（包括语气）的一致性。

原文: 7.7.2 Style
译文: 7.7.2 行文风格

原文: Style is mainly used to create the cosmetic appearance of sentences. By unifying the style, the structure of the document can clearly be shown to readers, which raises its readability.
译文: 行文风格主要用于塑造句子的外在表现形式。统一行文风格，可以向读者清楚展示文档结构，从而提高可读性。

原文: NOTE The structure of the document can be implied by applying different styles for each hierarchy.
译文: 注：为文档的不同层级采用不同的样式，可以体现文档结构。

原文: 7.7.2.2 Different styles
译文: 7.7.2.2 不同的行文风格

原文: Each of the styles given in Table 2 affects the characteristics of the document. When choosing the left-hand side styles, the document becomes more rigid and formal. When choosing right-hand side ones, the document becomes more casual and informal. A specific tone (or atmosphere) can be created by selecting each style from the list. When the tone to use has been decided, use it coherently.
译文: 表2列出的每一种行文风格都会影响文档的特征。选择左侧的行文风格，文档会更加拘谨、正式；选择右侧的行文风格，文档会更加随意、不拘形式。从表中选择各项行文风格，可以形成特定的语气（或氛围）。决定采用何种语气后，应连贯一致地使用。

原文: Decide on using the singular or plural form for each object and be consistent throughout the document, e.g. "document or documents", "it or they", "he/she or they".
译文: 确定每一对象使用单数形式还是复数形式，并在整份文档中保持一致，例如“document（文档，单数）或documents（文档，复数）”“it或they”“he/she或they”。

原文: When using the third-person pronoun, be gender neutral and always write both pronouns, e.g. "he or she", "s/he". Alternatively, use "they/them" to refer to the singular form.
译文: 使用第三人称代词时，应保持性别中立，始终同时写出两种代词，例如“he or she”（他或她）、“s/he”（她／他）。也可以使用“they/them”指代单数对象。

原文: 7.7.3 Tone

Tone is a set of styles that creates a specific atmosphere in a document. Many styles can affect the tone in English. If a variety of writing styles (e.g. a mixture of all of the styles given in Table 2) appear in a single document, it becomes complicated and disorganized, making it hard to read. If a manufacturer publishes such a document, it is possible that the manufacturer will be considered to be a mediocre company and the credibility of its products can be affected.
译文: 语气由一组行文风格构成，这组风格在文档中营造出特定氛围。在英语中，许多行文风格都会影响语气。如果同一份文档出现多种行文风格（例如混用表2中的全部行文风格），文档就会变得复杂、杂乱，难以阅读。如果制造商发布这样的文档，可能会被认为是一家平庸的公司，其产品的可信度也可能受到影响。

原文: Decide which styles to use from Table 2 and make a set of the rules. Follow this set of rules and be consistent when applying them.
译文: 从表2中确定要使用哪些行文风格，并据此制定一套规则。遵循这套规则，并在应用时保持一致。

原文: Difficulties and matters to be solved in communication
译文: 沟通中的困难与待解决的问题

原文: A.1 Communication difficulties
译文: A.1 沟通困难

原文: People can experience a variety of difficulties in communication in their daily lives. When translated from one language to another, these communication difficulties can further increase, including for syntax/grammar, word order, amount of information a language bears, pragmatics, deixis, morphology (inflectional language, isolated language, agglutinative language) and word complexity (e.g. homonymy). Some examples are given in this annex.
译文: 人们在日常沟通中会遇到各种困难。从一种语言翻译成另一种语言时，困难还可能进一步增加。这些困难涉及句法／语法、语序、语言所承载的信息量、语用、指示、形态（屈折语、孤立语、黏着语）以及词的复杂性（如同形同音异义）等。本附录给出一些例子。

原文: A.2 Sentence length
译文: A.2 句子长度

原文: Complex sentences are the basic problem in any language. People tend to unknowingly connect phrases, clauses and sentences into one long sentence, and their readers can have difficulties to understand the meaning. The difficulties generated by a long sentence include the following:
译文: 复杂句是任何语言中的基本问题。人们往往不知不觉地把短语、分句和句子连接成一个长句，使读者难以理解其含义。长句引起的困难包括：

原文: — including several topics;
译文: — 包含多个主题；

原文: — making complicated nested constructions;
译文: — 构成复杂的嵌套结构；

原文: — adding not-essential clauses to an essential information;
译文: — 在核心信息上附加非必要的分句；

原文: — adding a long modifier to a subject or predicative sentence;
译文: — 给主语或述谓句加上很长的修饰语；

原文: — changing viewpoints (or subjects) in a sentence.
译文: — 在同一句中变换观察角度或主语。

原文: A method how to avoid these problems is given in 7.3, starting with BSG Rule 2.1.
译文: 避免这些问题的方法见7.3，从BSG规则2.1开始。

原文: A.4 Amount of information a language bears
译文: A.4 语言所承载的信息量

原文: The amount of information a language bears is different depending on the language selected. It means that it can be necessary to compensate for missing information during translation. Typical examples are articles (arbitrary or specific), numbers (singular or plural) and genders (male, female, neutral).
译文: 不同语言所承载的信息量有所不同。这意味着翻译时可能需要补足缺少的信息。典型例子有冠词（任指或特指）、数（单数或复数）和性（阳性、阴性、中性）。

原文: A.5 Deixis (or conceptual recognition)
译文: A.5 指示（或概念认知）

原文: Spatial recognitions in English and Japanese are sometimes opposite. English gives the vertical expression (top to bottom) first and then the horizontal (left to right). Japanese gives the horizontal (left to right) first and then the vertical (top to bottom).
译文: 英语和日语的空间认知有时顺序相反。英语先给出垂直方向（上到下）的表达，再给出水平方向（左到右）；日语先给出水平方向（左到右），再给出垂直方向（上到下）。

译文: — “某一种称为time-flies（时间蝇）的苍蝇喜欢一支箭。”[11]

原文: 4 The LMF etymology extension
译文: 4 LMF词源扩展

原文: NOTE See Annex A for examples of possible etymological typologies.
译文: 注：可能的词源类型示例见附录A。

原文: 4.1 The Cognate class and the Etymon class
译文: 4.1 Cognate类与Etymon类

原文: Cognate and Etymon are defined as subclasses of the LexicalEntry class from the LMF core module (see Figure 1) $^{2}$ . Both classes define lexical entries which have been added to a lexical resource with the purpose of describing the etymologies of one or more other lexical entries. Instances of either Etymon or Cognate can be assigned a language which is different from the language of the lexicon as a whole (this is specified in the LexiconInformation class as described in ISO 24613-1).
译文: Cognate（同源词）类和Etymon（源词）类被定义为LMF核心模块中LexicalEntry（词条）类的子类（见图1）$^{2}$。这两个类所定义的词条，都是为描述一个或多个其他词条的词源而加入词汇资源的。可为Etymon或Cognate的实例指定一种语言。这种语言可以与整部辞典的语言不同。辞典整体使用的语言由LexiconInformation类指定，见ISO 24613-1。

原文: Individuals of both the Etymon and the Cognate classes shall be in an aggregation relationship with at least one individual of type EtyLink (see 4.3). When describing etymologies, there are cases in which it is necessary to deal with instances of LexicalEntry (and hence also by the subclass relation instances of Etymon and Cognate) which are roots, and in particular reconstructed roots. In these cases, the fact of being a root and the type of the root in question shall be specified using the attribute rootType. In the case of reconstructed roots or other word forms, the attribute status serves to associate the element with a written description of the likelihood of its having been in use (see the example in A.8). See Table 1 for a list of attributes to be used with these two classes.
译文: Etymon类和Cognate类的每个实例，都应与至少一个EtyLink类型的实例形成聚合关系（见4.3）。描述词源时，有时需要用LexicalEntry实例表示词根，尤其是拟构词根。Etymon和Cognate是LexicalEntry的子类，因此也适用这一情况。此时，应使用rootType属性指明该实例是词根，并注明词根的类型。对于拟构词根或其他词形，status属性用于为该要素关联一段文字，说明它曾被使用的可能性（见A.8示例）。这两个类可用的属性见表1。

原文: 4.2 The Etymologizable class
译文: 4.2 Etymologizable类

原文: The Etymologizable class provides a means of referring to the set of linguistic elements that can have etymologies. By defining a single class encompassing all such 'etymologizable' elements, the classes of elements which can have etymologies can be easily extended in the future wherever the necessity arises. The following classes are subtypes of the Etymologizable class (see Figure 2): LexicalEntry, Sense, Form and CognateSet (see 4.4).
译文: Etymologizable（可作词源分析的要素）类提供了一种统一指称可具有词源的语言要素的方式。把所有这类要素纳入同一个类后，今后如有需要，就能方便地扩展可具有词源的要素类别。下列类是Etymologizable的子类型（见图2）：LexicalEntry、Sense、Form和CognateSet（见4.4）。

原文: 4.3 The Etymology class and the EtyLink class
译文: 4.3 Etymology类与EtyLink类

原文: Instances of Etymology are associated with one or more EtyLink instances, each of which represents a single stage or step in the etymology of a given lexical item (see Figure 4). EtyLink serves to link together individuals belonging to the subclasses of Etymologizable. EtyLink is a subclass of the CrossREF class as defined in ISO 24613-1. The use of CrossREF requires that the target objects representing the given lexical content be given id attributes. The use of the id attribute on an individual of the Etymologizable class as a target allows for the modelling of a generic sequential temporal ordering of multiple elements, using the attributes prev and next. Instances of the EtyLink class can further specify additional temporal relationships using various temporal attributes associated with the source and target of each EtyLink instance.
译文:
Etymology实例与一个或多个EtyLink实例关联；每个EtyLink表示某一词汇单位词源中的一个阶段或步骤（见图4）。EtyLink用于连接属于Etymologizable各子类的实例。它是ISO 24613-1所定义的CrossREF（交叉引用）类的子类。

使用CrossREF时，必须为表示相应词汇内容的目标对象赋予id属性。以Etymologizable实例的id作为引用目标，再配合prev和next属性，就能建立多个要素按时间先后排列的一般顺序。EtyLink实例还可使用与各链接源端和目标端有关的多种时间属性，进一步指定其他时间关系。

原文: Individuals of the Etymon and Cognate classes (subtypes of LexicalEntry) shall be associated with at least one individual of EtyLink. See Table 1 for a list of attributes to be used with the Etymology and EtyLink classes.
译文: Etymon类和Cognate类（均为LexicalEntry的子类型）的每个实例，都应与至少一个EtyLink实例关联。Etymology类和EtyLink类可用的属性见表1。

原文: 4.4 The CognateSet class
译文: 4.4 CognateSet类

原文: The CognateSet class (see Figure 5) is a container for sets of one or more Cognate items and zero or more Bibliography items (see ISO 24613-2). The CognateSet is a construct related to onomasiology. Its contents are items from languages related to that of a given LexicalEntry (and therefore by the subclass relation of any given Etymon or Cognate) and which have been gathered together with the purpose of demonstrating linguistic similarities or dissimilarities of salient kinds. The use of CognateSet implies that the LexicalEntry (and therefore Etymon and Cognate) instances which it contains share an etymological source.
译文: CognateSet（同源词集）类（见图5）是一个容器，可容纳一个或多个Cognate项，以及零个或多个Bibliography项（见ISO 24613-2）。CognateSet是一种与称名学有关的构造。其内容来自与某一LexicalEntry所用语言有亲属关系的语言；由于子类关系，这也适用于任何Etymon或Cognate。将这些项汇集起来，是为了展示某些显著的语言相似性或差异。使用CognateSet意味着其中的LexicalEntry实例（因而也包括Etymon和Cognate实例）具有共同词源。

原文: 4.5 The Date class
译文: 4.5 Date类

原文: The components of a LexicalEntry and its subclasses shall be associated with a specific date by making use of the Date class. Furthermore, Date allows the specification of a number of degrees of precision. A precise year, and potentially month and day, shall be stated using the date attribute and a rough date with the attribute circa. Within a span of time with different levels of specificity, there is the possibility of using one or more dating attributes. Where a span of time is known (or asserted), the lower and upper ends of the span can be specified using notBefore, notAfter respectively. For date and time formats, ISO 8601-1 and ISO 8601-2 shall be used.
译文: 应使用Date（日期）类，为LexicalEntry及其子类的组成部分关联具体日期。Date也支持不同精度：精确的年份（也可包括月和日）应使用date属性表示；约略日期应使用circa属性表示。表示不同精度的时间范围时，可以使用一个或多个日期属性。对于已知（或被认定）的时间区间，可分别使用notBefore和notAfter指定区间的下界和上界。日期和时间格式应采用ISO 8601-1和ISO 8601-2。

原文: 4.6 The Gloss class
译文: 4.6 Gloss类

原文: The Gloss class (see Figure 6) represents a textual description of the meaning of a word or a phrase that is intended for human consumption. Individuals of the class can either represent paraphrases or synonyms and these may be in the language of the entry or in another language. See Table 1 for a list of attributes to be used with this class.
译文: Gloss（释义）类（见图6）表示供人阅读的词或短语意义的文字说明。该类实例可以给出释义性转述或同义词，既可使用词条本身的语言，也可使用另一种语言。该类可用的属性见表1。

原文: Examples of possible etymological typologies
译文: 可能的词源类型示例

原文: A.1 Example of simple inheritance
译文: A.1 简单继承示例

原文: The example in Figure A.1 describes the inheritance of a lexical entry from a parent language, in this case the adverb semper in Sardinian which comes from the Latin word semper. The Sardinian word is linked to a single Etymology instance which is associated with the type inheritance (see Annex B for a definition of this type). The Etymology is then associated with an individual of type EtyLink which represents the process of change from the Latin etymon to the Sardinian lexical entry.
译文: 图A.1的示例描述了词条从祖语继承而来的情况：撒丁语副词semper来自拉丁语semper。这个撒丁语词与一个Etymology实例相连，该实例的类型为inheritance（此类型的定义见附录B）。Etymology再与一个EtyLink类型的实例关联，用以表示从拉丁语源词到撒丁语词条的变化过程。

原文: A.2 Example of a diachronic etymological process (inheritance with phonological change)
译文: A.2 历时词源过程示例（伴随音系变化的继承）

原文: In the following example, the development of the word meaning ‘wine’ (ipa: [ven]) in the Emiliano variety of Italian is traced back using a series of Etymons which are ordered and linked together using EtyLink instances, from the Vulgar Latin vinu through to the immediate predecessor of the word in its current manifestation. These individual links can be accessed through an Etymology individual (with the type inheritance) which represents the history of the LexicalEntry. The ordering of EtyLinks is implemented by means of the two attributes prev and next. These attributes are not displayed in Figure A.2 for reasons of space, but their use is shown in Figure A.6, for the example given in A.6, and in Figure A.10, for the example given in A.8.
译文:
下面的示例借助一系列Etymon，追溯意大利语艾米利亚变体中表示“葡萄酒”的词（IPA：[ven]）的发展。这些Etymon由EtyLink实例连接并排序，序列从通俗拉丁语vinu开始，一直延伸到该词现今形式的直接前身。

这些单独的链接可通过一个类型为inheritance的Etymology实例访问；该实例表示整个LexicalEntry的历史。EtyLink的排序由prev和next两个属性实现。因篇幅所限，图A.2未显示这两个属性；其用法可参见A.6示例的图A.6，以及A.8示例的图A.10。

原文: A.3 Example of word form inheritance
译文: A.3 词形继承示例

原文: NOTE This etymology can be further articulated by adding the phonological process types for each stage of the diachrony. This can done in the model by adding the appropriate data category defined in Annex B to the value of type on the EtyLink for the given stages.
译文: 注：可以为历时演变的各阶段添加相应的音系过程类型，从而进一步细化这个词源描述。在模型中，可将附录B定义的适当数据类别加入相应阶段EtyLink的type属性值，以实现这一点。

原文: A.4 Example of metaphorical semantic shift
译文: A.4 隐喻性词义转变示例

原文: The example in Figure A.4 from Mixtepec-Mixtec shows the derivation of one sense from another via metaphor. In this case, the word translating to 'kidney' was derived from a metaphorical extension of the word meaning 'bean' ntuchi. The Etymology is attached to the kidney sense of the word ntuchi. The EtyLink instance contains the attributes source and target with the id values of the respective components specifying the directionality of the process. As a defining feature of the process of metaphor is that there has to be a change in the semantic domain between the source and target sense, each sense has a domain specified in the subject field. The CrossREF class defined in ISO 24613-2 is used to specify a URI corresponding to the dbpedia entry for each sense.
译文:
图A.4中的Mixtepec-Mixtec语示例，展示一个义项通过隐喻从另一个义项产生的过程。其中，表示“肾脏”的词，来自意为“豆子”的ntuchi的隐喻性引申。Etymology关联到ntuchi的“肾脏”义项。

EtyLink实例包含source和target属性，分别以相应组成部分的id为值，指明过程的方向。隐喻过程的一个界定特征，是源义项与目标义项之间必须发生语义域的转换，因此每个义项都通过subject字段指定所属域。ISO 24613-2定义的CrossREF类用于指定与各义项的DBpedia条目对应的URI。

原文: A.5 Example of borrowing and compounding
译文: A.5 借用与复合构词示例

原文: A.6 Example of use of temporal information
译文: A.6 时间信息的使用示例

原文: The example in Figure A.6 shows the encoding of the etymology of the French lexical item chef with a focus on the diachronic stages and time frame of its phonetic development (see Reference $[13]$ ). Herein at the level of Etymology, the process specifying the fact that chef was inherited from Latin is encoded in the attribute type which is given the value "inheritance". Within the Etymology, there is a series of Etymon items containing the temporal attributes notBefore and notAfter which are used to specify the spans of time, and the sequential ordering asserted is that a given form of the item would have been in use. Note also the ordering of Etymon items via the use of prev and next attributes on the appropriate EtyLink individuals.
译文:
图A.6展示法语词汇单位chef的词源编码，重点是其语音发展的历时阶段和时间范围（见参考文献[13]）。在Etymology层面，type属性取值“inheritance”，表示chef继承自拉丁语。

Etymology内部有一系列Etymon项，包含notBefore和notAfter时间属性，用以指定各个时间区间；这些区间及所断定的先后次序，表示该词某一形式被认为曾经使用的时期。还应注意，Etymon项的顺序通过相应EtyLink实例上的prev和next属性表示。

原文: A.7 CognateSet with Bibliography
译文: A.7 含Bibliography的CognateSet

原文: Figure A.7 shows an example of a cognate set as taken from an actual etymological dictionary source (see Reference [19]). A number of cognate forms in related languages are given to compare to the lexical item girl. Although the LexicalEntry is inherently part of the CognateSet, this relationship is assumed and thus it is not represented as Cognate in the encoding.
译文: 图A.7展示了一个取自实际词源辞典的同源词集示例（见参考文献[19]）。其中列出亲属语言中的若干同源形式，用于与词汇单位girl比较。LexicalEntry本身也是CognateSet的组成部分，但这一关系被视为已知，因此编码中未另将它表示为Cognate。

原文: A major point of interest in this entry is the fact that the lexical entry girl, whose contemporary English sense is given in the Definition for the main entry, was used early on to denote a young person regardless of gender, and therefore became subject to a semantic shift over its long period of use. Each Cognate has an associated Sense and a Definition instance which together describe related lexical entries in Germanic languages, all of which are hypothesised as having been inherited from a common source.
译文: 这个词条有一点尤其值得关注：主词条的Definition给出了girl在当代英语中的义项，但girl早期曾用于指称任何性别的年轻人，因此在长期使用中发生了词义转变。每个Cognate都与一个Sense和一个Definition实例关联，二者共同描述日耳曼语族语言中的相关词条。这些词条都被假定继承自同一个来源。

原文: A.8 Comprehensive etymological example
译文: A.8 综合词源示例

原文: In order to demonstrate some of the expressivity of the current model and its potential for dealing with realistic examples of etymological data, the etymological information of part of a single entry, namely the entry for the Latin word amārus ‘bitter’ in Figure A.8[6], is modelled in Figures A.9 and A.10.
译文: 为展示本模型的部分表达能力，以及处理真实词源数据的潜力，图A.9和图A.10对一个词条的部分词源信息进行了建模。该词条是图A.8[6]中的拉丁语amārus“苦的”。

原文: The entry consists of a listing of two of the word's derivatives along with a series of its etymons and cognates. The entry also contains a paragraph of textual commentary on the etymology of amārus (that is the paragraph starting with 'The suffix –arus'...); this commentary is not modelled as structured data in the example. The original text of the entry is shown in Figure A.8.
译文: 该词条列出这个词的两个派生词，以及一系列源词和同源词。词条还包含一段关于amārus词源的文字评述，即以“The suffix –arus…”开头的段落；本例未将这段评述建模为结构化数据。词条原文见图A.8。

原文: amārus 'bitter' [adj. o/ā] (Pl.+)
译文: amārus ‘苦的’ [形容词，o/ā类]（Pl.+）

原文: Derivatives: amāritūdō 'bitterness' (Varro+), amāror [m.] 'bitter taste' (Lucr.+). Pt. *o/am-?
译文: 派生词：amāritūdō ‘苦、苦味’（Varro+），amāror [阳性] ‘苦味’（Lucr.+）。Pt. *o/am-?

原文: Figure A.8 — Sample entry of Latin amārus
译文: 图A.8——拉丁语amārus词条示例

原文: The modelling of this entry is presented in two parts. First is a diagram (Figure A.9) which details the LMF modelling of the first two lines of the entry (shown in Figure A.8): the lines containing the lemma, meaning and part of speech of the lexical entry as well as its derivatives. In the LMF modelling of the entry, the lexical entry amārus is linked to its derivatives using the CrossREF element (defined in ISO 24613-2). CrossREF is used as a means of modelling the attestation of a given derivation or sense of the entry. The CrossREF individuals in question are typed as attestations using the attribute type, and with any additional information (in this case the presence of the plus sign after the bibliographic citation in Reference [6] means that the linguistic usage in question can also be found in later sources) added as text using the note attribute. In this instance, the bibliographic element refers to a single author (and therefore to their corpus of works) and the date attribute refers to the whole period encompassing their lifespan.
译文:
该词条的建模分为两部分。第一部分是图A.9，详细展示图A.8词条前两行的LMF建模：这两行包含词条的词目形式、意义、词类及其派生词。建模时，词条amārus通过CrossREF元素（定义见ISO 24613-2）连接到其派生词。

CrossREF还用于表示某一派生形式或词条义项的见证记录。这些CrossREF实例通过type属性标为见证记录，其他信息则通过note属性以文字添加。本例中的附加信息是：参考文献[6]的文献引注后若有加号，表示该语言用法也见于较晚的来源。这里的文献元素指向一位作者，因而也指向其作品集合；date属性则覆盖这位作者的整个生存年代。

原文: The second part of the example (Figure A.10) details the modelling of the etymological information itself (for ease of reading the elements of each of the two cognate sets are coloured using two different colours, cyan and purple). The Cognates are each shown as belonging to one of two CognateSet elements and the entire etymology is attributed to the source by associating the Bibliography with the Etymology element for the LexicalEntry. Two other Etymology elements are used to describe etymologies for Cognates included within the CognateSet. The attribute rootType is used to indicate that the form of the etymon is reconstructed, and the attribute status to indicate a level of uncertainty.
译文:
示例的第二部分（图A.10）详细展示词源信息本身的建模。为便于阅读，两个同源词集中的要素分别用青色和紫色表示。各个Cognate都归属于两个CognateSet元素中的一个；通过将Bibliography与LexicalEntry的Etymology元素关联，整个词源分析便被归于相应来源。

另外两个Etymology元素用于描述CognateSet内同源词自身的词源。rootType属性用于标明源词形式是拟构的，status属性用于标明不确定程度。

原文: A.9 Model simplification
译文: A.9 模型简化

原文: Several examples in this Annex illustrate approaches for model simplification. See ISO 24613-1:2019, 5.5 (Methods for data category selection and subclass creation), and in particular, 5.5.6 (Principles for model simplification), for a normative description of the simplification process.
译文: 本附录的若干示例展示了模型简化的方法。简化过程的规范性说明见ISO 24613-1:2019的5.5（数据类别选择与子类创建方法），尤其是5.5.6（模型简化原则）。

原文: Data categories for etymology description
译文: 词源描述的数据类别

原文: This annex contains a structured list of categories that shall be used as possible values for describing etymological processes, including sound changes as well as relevant lexical subfeatures. It describes, for each category, its name, a camel case representation, a conceptual domain (for complex data categories), a definition (with its source(s)), one or several examples (with their source(s) when applicable), as well as some usage notes where needed.
译文: 本附录给出一份结构化的类别清单；这些类别应作为描述词源过程的可能取值，涵盖音变及有关词汇子特征。每个类别均列出名称、驼峰式表示、概念域（用于复杂数据类别）、定义及其来源、一个或多个示例及适用时的来源，并在需要时提供用法说明。

原文: Where applicable, the camel case form should be used in utilizing the features as a value for the attribute type in declaring the process of an Etymology or EtyLink.
译文: 在适用的情况下，用这些特征作为type属性值来声明Etymology或EtyLink的过程时，宜采用驼峰式形式。

原文: NOTE These features are not exhaustive and do not account for all the possible theoretical super- and sub-typologies and variant definitions or descriptions.
译文: 注：这些特征并非穷尽性清单，也未涵盖所有可能的理论上位类型、下位类型，以及定义或描述的变体。

原文: Borrowing
译文: 借用

原文: Calque
译文: 仿译

原文:
Camel case code: calque 

Definition: A loanword in which only the meaning is borrowed with the term being literally translated into the borrowing language. 

Source: Reference [5]. 

Example: Spanish rascacielos (rasca 'scratch', 'scrape' + cielos 'sky') from English skyscraper 

Alternate term: loan translation, semantic loan
译文:
驼峰式代码：calque

定义：一种只借入意义、通过将原词语直译成借入语而形成的借词。

来源：参考文献[5]。

示例：西班牙语rascacielos（rasca“抓、刮”+ cielos“天空”）来自英语skyscraper。

其他术语：借译、语义借用

原文: Inheritance
译文: 继承

原文:
Camel case code: inheritance 

Definition: Inheritance, although often not regarded as an etymological process in itself, is used to identify situations where a lexical item is known to, or is presumed to, have been inherited from a predecessor or “parent” language(s). Items inherited from a predecessor language often undergo any number of different separate etymological processes over the course of their diachrony. 

Source: Reference [4]. 

Example: Sardinian semper was inherited from Latin semper.
译文:
驼峰式代码：inheritance

定义：继承常常不被视为一种独立的词源过程，但可用来标示某一词汇单位已知或被推定继承自前身语言或“祖语”的情况。从前身语言继承的词汇单位，在历时发展过程中，往往还会经历数量不等、彼此不同的词源过程。

来源：参考文献[4]。

示例：撒丁语semper继承自拉丁语semper。

原文: Compounding
译文: 复合构词

原文: Derivation
译文: 派生

原文:
Camel case code: derivation 

Definition: Derivation is the process by which new lexical items or inflectable stems are formed by the addition of an affix. The derived lexical items are often of a different class than the original, in such cases they will take the inflectional affixes of the new word class. 

Example: Silacayoapan Mixtec uses the nominalizing prefix “ñā -” to create new nouns from other parts of speech: tu hún ‘to lie’ > ñā -tu hún ‘a lie’.
译文:
驼峰式代码：derivation

定义：通过添加词缀，形成新的词汇单位或可屈折词干的过程。派生所得词汇单位的词类往往不同于原词；在这种情况下，它们会采用新词类的屈折词缀。

示例：Silacayoapan Mixtec语使用名词化前缀“ñā -”，将其他词类的词变成新名词：tu hún“说谎” > ñā -tu hún“谎言”。

原文: Back formation
译文: 逆构词

原文:
Camel case code: backFormation 

Definition: Back formation is generally a type of folk etymology in which either a word is modified morphologically based on mistaken assumptions of its morphological composition, or in which a new word of one class is created based on root components of another. 

Source: Adapted from Reference [5]. 

Example: English cherry, a loanword from Old French cheris (Modern French cerise) was assumed to be plural because of the -s, thus the singular form in English was adapted to cherry and the plural cherries. An example of the second type of back formation can be found in the English verb to conversate from the noun conversation. 

Alternative term: retrograde formation
译文:
驼峰式代码：backFormation

定义：逆构词通常是民间词源的一种。其中，一种情况是基于对词的形态组成的错误判断，改变该词的形态；另一种情况是依据某一词类词语的词根成分，创造另一词类的新词。

来源：改编自参考文献[5]。

示例：英语cherry借自古法语cheris（现代法语cerise）。由于词尾-s，它被误认为复数，于是英语将单数形式调整为cherry，复数形式为cherries。第二类逆构词的例子，是从名词conversation产生英语动词to conversate。

其他术语：逆向构词

原文: Portmanteau
译文: 混成构词

原文:
Camel case code: portmanteau 

Definition: Generally the difference between compounding and portmanteau is that compounds do not involve the contraction of their component forms. In this process, like in compounding, portmanteau items are created via one or more cognitive semantic processes such as metaphor and metonymy and thus can be classified and analysed etymologically according to the particular mechanisms underlying the compound's creation on the semantic level. 

Example: The word Brexit which is the noun referring to the exit of Great Britain from the European Union is a portmanteau of Britain + exit. 

Alternative term: blending, blend, fusion 

Note: It should be noted that while there is theoretical overlap between the ideas, the term “blending” with regards to this particular word formation process should not be attributed to the conceptual blending theory developed in References $[8]$ and $[9]$ .
译文:
驼峰式代码：portmanteau

定义：复合构词与混成构词的区别通常在于，复合词的组成形式不发生缩合。混成构词与复合构词相似，也可通过隐喻、转喻等一个或多个认知语义过程形成词汇单位。因此，可以根据其形成过程中起作用的具体语义机制，从词源角度分类和分析。

示例：Brexit是表示英国退出欧洲联盟的名词，由Britain + exit混成。

其他术语：混成、混成词、融合

注：应注意，尽管相关概念在理论上有所重叠，此处用于这一特定构词过程的“混成”一词不宜归于参考文献[8]和[9]所提出的概念整合理论。

原文: Narrowing
译文: 词义缩小

原文:
Camel case code: narrowing 

Definition: The process of semantic change where over time a term is used to refer to a more restricted aspect of its original meaning. 

Example: In Old English the ancestor to the modern English word meat originally referred to food in general but then its sense narrowed to refer only to 'flesh used as food'. 

Alternate term: hyponymic shift
译文:
驼峰式代码：narrowing

定义：一种语义变化过程，词语随时间转而用于指称其原义中范围更受限制的部分。

示例：现代英语meat的古英语前身原来泛指食物，后来词义缩小，仅指“作为食物的肉”。

其他术语：向下义转变

原文: Widening
译文: 词义扩大

原文:
Camel case code: widening 

Definition: The process of semantic change where over time a term is used to refer to a more general aspect of its original meaning. 

Example: The English word camp (n) originally pertained to military specific location with open, level space but has generalized to non-military senses by the 1580's. 

Alternate term: broadening, extension, generalization, hypernymic shift
译文:
驼峰式代码：widening

定义：一种语义变化过程，词语随时间转而用于指称比原义更一般的方面。

示例：英语名词camp原先专指空间开阔、地面平坦的军事地点；到16世纪80年代，其词义已经扩展到非军事用法。

其他术语：扩展、引申、泛化、向上义转变

原文: Amelioration
译文: 词义褒化

原文:
Camel case code: amelioration 

Definition: The process by which the sense of a word which formerly has some negative connotation changes to a positive or at least a reduced degree of negativity. 

Example: The English word knight originally meant a boy who was a servant or attendant (c.f., the German word knecht) but has become a word to designate a rank of nobility.
译文:
驼峰式代码：amelioration

定义：一个词的词义由带有某种负面色彩转为带有正面色彩，或至少负面色彩有所减弱的过程。

示例：英语knight原指充当仆人或侍从的男孩（比较德语knecht），后来成为表示某种贵族等级的词。

原文: Pejoration
译文: 词义贬化

原文:
Camel case code: pejoration 

Definition: The process by which the sense of a word which formerly has a neutral or positive connotation changes to a negative or at least a reduced degree of positivity. 

Example: The word puttana, which in its original Latin form just meant ‘young woman’, in Italian means ‘prostitute’ or ‘slut’. 

Alternate term: derogation, worsening
译文:
驼峰式代码：pejoration

定义：一个词的词义由带有中性或正面色彩转为带有负面色彩，或至少正面色彩有所减弱的过程。

示例：puttana的原始拉丁语形式只表示“年轻女子”，而在意大利语中表示“妓女”或“荡妇”。

其他术语：贬损、恶化

原文: Metaphor
译文: 隐喻

原文:
Camel case code: metaphor 

Definition: The process of metaphor as a vehicle of lexical change is based in cognitive processes by which one concept from domain X is understood in terms of another concept from domain Y. This is mirrored lexically, where one concept in a given domain is described or referred to using lexical items (and/or vocabulary) from another. The driving forces for this process are ontological correspondences between the attributes or internal structures of entities in the source domain with those of the target domain. 

Source: Adapted from References [14] and [15]. 

Note: Metaphor in the context of etymology is differentiated from other spontaneous uses in language by the need for the term to be adopted (lexicalized) within the lexicon. 

Note: Metaphor (where occurring not in the context of compounding or portmanteau) gives rise to lexical polysemy. 

Example: Mixtepec-Mixtec 

sa'a 'foot (person or animal)' > 'bottom part (of an object)'
译文:
驼峰式代码：metaphor

定义：作为词汇变化手段的隐喻，基于这样一种认知过程：借助Y域的另一个概念来理解X域中的某个概念。词汇层面也反映了这一点，即使用另一概念域的词汇单位及／或词汇，来描述或指称某一域中的概念。这一过程的推动力，是源域实体与目标域实体在属性或内部结构上的本体论对应关系。

来源：改编自参考文献[14]和[15]。

注：词源研究中的隐喻，要求相关用语被词汇系统接受，即发生词汇化；这一点使其区别于语言中其他自发的隐喻使用。

注：隐喻若不发生在复合构词或混成构词的语境中，会产生词汇多义性。

示例：Mixtepec-Mixtec语

sa'a ‘人或动物的脚’ > ‘物体的底部’

原文: Metonymy
译文: 转喻

原文:
Camel case code: metonymy 

Definition: Like metaphor, metonymy is another process based in human cognition which is reflected in language and leads to synchronic lexical polysemy. In metonymy, one vehicle entity provides mental access to a target entity within a single domain by highlighting different aspects of part-whole relationships (meronymy). 

Source: Adapted from Reference [12]. 

Example: Mixtepec-Mixtec 

I. nuu 'face (of a person or animal)' > 'the front (of a person or animal)' 

II. nuu ‘the front (of a person or animal)’ > ‘in front (of a person or animal)’
译文:
驼峰式代码：metonymy

定义：与隐喻一样，转喻也是一种基于人类认知、反映在语言中并导致共时词汇多义性的过程。转喻在同一概念域内，通过突出部分—整体关系的不同方面，以一个作为媒介的实体，引导人们在认知上指向目标实体。

来源：改编自参考文献[12]。

示例：Mixtepec-Mixtec语

I. nuu ‘人或动物的脸’ > ‘人或动物的正面’

II. nuu ‘人或动物的正面’ > ‘在人或动物前面’

原文: Grammaticalization
译文: 语法化

原文:
Camel case code: grammaticalization 

Definition: Diachronically, grammaticalization is a unidirectional process through which lexical items over time become more grammatical in nature. Central to grammaticalization is a continuum of bondedness in which on one end are lexical items which are semantically richer and which occur in relatively free syntactic constructions and on the other are items which are less semantically rich and which may occur in much more restricted (morpho-)syntactic contexts. At the extreme of the latter end of the continuum items may disappear altogether. 

Source: Adapted from References [16] and [20]. 

Note: Complex category which may involve various combinations of discourse, morpho-syntactic, semantic and possibly phonological changes to a lexical item. 

Example: Old English to Modern English 

a:n 'one' > a(n) indefinite article
译文:
驼峰式代码：grammaticalization

定义：从历时角度看，语法化是一种单向过程，词汇单位随时间推移变得更具语法性质。其核心是一条结合程度的连续统：一端的词汇单位语义较丰富，能够出现在相对自由的句法结构中；另一端的单位语义较贫乏，可能出现在限制更严格的句法或形态句法环境中。在后一端的极限处，这些单位可能完全消失。

来源：改编自参考文献[16]和[20]。

注：这是一个复杂类别，可能涉及词汇单位在话语、形态句法、语义方面的多种变化组合，也可能涉及音系变化。

示例：从古英语到现代英语

a:n“一个” > a(n) 不定冠词

原文: Folk Etymology
译文: 民间词源

原文: Assimilation
译文: 同化

原文:
Camel case code: assimilation 

Definition: The historical phonological process by which a sound assimilates in part or in entirety to one or more features of a neighbouring sound. 

Source: Reference [5]. 

Note: There are numerous potential subvarieties of assimilation along several different dichotomies and traits, which can intersect, these are: total-partial, contact-distant, and regressive-progressive. Additionally, subvarieties of assimilation can be referred to according to the specific phonological feature involved: e.g. voicing, nasalization, place.
译文:
驼峰式代码：assimilation

定义：一个音在部分或全部方面趋同于邻近音的一个或多个特征的历时音系过程。

来源：参考文献[5]。

注：同化可按多组二分标准及特征分成许多可能交叉的子类，包括完全／部分、接触／远距离，以及逆行／顺行。还可依据涉及的具体音系特征命名同化子类，例如浊化、鼻化和发音部位同化。

原文: Dissimilation
译文: 异化

原文:
Camel case code: dissimilation 

Definition: The historical phonological process by which a sound becomes less similar in one or more features to a neighbouring sound. This process is the opposite of assimilation. 

Source: Adapted from Reference [10]. 

Note: The change realized in a process of dissimilation will likely involve another phonological process. The example below involves hardening. 

Example: Greek: [fθinos] > [ftinos] 'cheap'
译文:
驼峰式代码：dissimilation

定义：一个音在一个或多个特征上变得与邻近音更不相似的历时音系过程。该过程与同化相反。

来源：改编自参考文献[10]。

注：异化过程中发生的具体变化，很可能还涉及另一种音系过程。下例涉及强化。

示例：希腊语[fθinos] > [ftinos] ‘便宜的’

原文: Deletion
译文: 脱落

原文: Syncope
译文: 词中音脱落

原文: Apocope
译文: 词尾音脱落

原文:
Camel case code: apocope 

Definition: The historical phonological process in which one or more sounds are lost at the end of a lexical item. While the term usually applies to vowels, it can occur with consonants as well. 

Source: Reference [5]. 

Example: Old English sticca > Modern English stick
译文:
驼峰式代码：apocope

定义：词汇单位末尾的一个或多个音消失的历时音系过程。该术语通常用于元音，也可以用于辅音。

来源：参考文献[5]。

示例：古英语sticca > 现代英语stick。

原文: Aphaeresis
译文: 词首音脱落

原文:
Camel case code: aphaeresis 

Definition: The historical phonological process in which the initial sounds of a word are lost. 

Source: Reference [5]. 

Example: Latin apotēca > Spanish bodega 

Alternate term: apheresis
译文:
驼峰式代码：aphaeresis

定义：词首的音消失的历时音系过程。

来源：参考文献[5]。

示例：拉丁语apotēca > 西班牙语bodega。

其他术语：词首音脱落（apheresis）

原文: Epenthesis
译文: 增音

原文: Metathesis
译文: 音位换位

原文:
Camel case code: metathesis 

Definition: The historical phonological process by which sounds or segments are rearranged within a lexical item. 

Example: Latin parabola > Spanish palabra
译文:
驼峰式代码：metathesis

定义：词汇单位内部的音或音段重新排列的历时音系过程。

示例：拉丁语parabola > 西班牙语palabra。

原文: Fortition
译文: 强化

原文: Lenition
译文: 弱化

原文: Voicing
译文: 浊化

原文:
Camel case code: voicing 

Definition: The historical phonological process in which a voiceless phone becomes voiced. 

Example: [t] > [d]
译文:
驼峰式代码：voicing

定义：清音变为浊音的历时音系过程。

示例：[t] > [d]

原文: Devoicing
译文: 清化

原文:
Camel case code: devoicing 

Definition: The historical phonological process in which a voiced phone becomes unvoiced. 

Example: [d] > [t]
译文:
驼峰式代码：devoicing

定义：浊音变为清音的历时音系过程。

示例：[d] > [t]

原文: Introduction
译文: 引言

原文: ISO/TC 37/SC 4 focuses on the definition of models and formats for the representation of annotated language resources. To this end, it has generalized the modelling strategy initiated by its sister committee, ISO/TC 37/SC 3, for the representation of terminological data (see Reference [21]), through which linguistic data models are seen as the combination of a generic data pattern (a metamodel), which is further refined through a selection of data categories that provide the descriptors for this specific annotation level. Such models are defined independently of any specific formats and ensure that an implementer has the necessary conceptual instrument with which to design and compare formats with regard to their degrees of interoperability.
译文: ISO/TC 37/SC 4着重制定用于表示已标注语言资源的模型和格式。为此，该分委员会将其同级委员会ISO/TC 37/SC 3为术语数据表示提出的建模策略加以推广（见参考文献[21]）：语言数据模型由通用数据模式（即元模型）与选定的数据类别共同构成，后者提供特定标注层所需的描述项，使模型进一步具体化。这些模型的定义不依赖某种具体格式，可为实施者提供概念工具，用来设计格式并比较不同格式的互操作程度。

原文: One important aspect of representing any kind of annotation is the capacity to provide a clear and reliable semantics for the various descriptors used, either in the form of formal features and feature values, or directly as objects in a representation that is expressed, for instance, in XML. In order to be shared across various annotation schemas and encoding applications, such semantics should be implemented as a centralized repository of concepts: these concepts will henceforth be referred to as data categories. These data categories are envisioned as having the following two properties:
译文: 表示任何一种标注时，重要的一点是为所用的各种描述项提供清楚、可靠的语义。这些描述项既可表达为形式化特征及特征值，也可直接作为对象出现在以XML等形式表达的表示结构中。为使语义能在不同标注模式和编码应用之间共享，宜将其组织为集中式概念库；下文将这些概念称为数据类别。预期这些数据类别具有以下两项性质：

原文: — From a descriptive point of view, each unique semantic reference should be associated with precise documentation combining a full text elicitation of the meaning of the descriptor with the expression of specific constraints that bear upon the category.
译文: — 从描述角度看，每个唯一的语义引用都宜有精确的配套说明，既用完整文字阐明描述项的含义，也说明作用于该类别的具体约束。

原文: In the ISO 12620 series, a general framework for representing and maintaining such a repository of data categories has been developed, potentially encompassing all domains of language resources.
译文: ISO 12620系列已经建立表示和维护此类数据类别库的通用框架，其适用范围可覆盖语言资源的各个领域。

原文: A possible instantiation of ISO 12620-1 is a “flat” marketplace of semantic objects, providing only a limited set of ontological constraints. The objective of such a setup would be to facilitate the maintenance of a comprehensive descriptive environment where new categories are easily inserted and re-used without the need for any strong consistency check with the repository at large. Indeed, the following kinds of constraints are part of the data category model, as defined in ISO 12620-1:
译文: ISO 12620-1的一种可能实现方式，是建立一个“扁平”的语义对象集市，只施加有限的本体约束。这样可以便于维护一个覆盖全面的描述环境，使新类别易于加入和复用，而无须严格检查这些新类别与整个库的一致性。ISO 12620-1规定的数据类别模型确实包含以下几类约束：

原文: - Simple generic-specific relations, when these are useful for the proper identification of interoperability descriptors between data categories. For instance, the fact that /properNoun/ is a sub-category of /noun/ makes it possible to compare morphosyntactic annotations based on different descriptive levels of granularity.
译文: — 简单的属种关系：当这类关系有助于准确识别数据类别之间用于互操作的描述项时，可予以采用。例如，/properNoun/是/noun/的子类别这一事实，使采用不同描述粒度的形态句法标注能够相互比较。

原文: — The description of conceptual domains that make it possible to identify, when known or applicable, the range of the possible values of so-called “complex data categories”. For instance, it can be used to record that possible values of /grammaticalGender/ (limited to a small group of languages, see Reference [21]), can be a subset of {/masculine/, /feminine/ and /neuter/}.
译文: — 对概念域的描述：在已知或适用时，可以据此确定所谓“复杂数据类别”的可能取值范围。例如，它可记录/grammaticalGender/的可能取值可为{/masculine/、/feminine/、/neuter/}的一个子集；这一示例仅适用于少数语言，见参考文献[21]。

原文: — Language-specific constraints, either in the form of specific application notes or as explicit restrictions bearing upon the conceptual domains of complex data categories. For instance, it is possible to express explicitly that /grammaticalGender/ in French can only take the two values: {/masculine/ and /feminine/}.
译文: — 语言特定约束：可以采用具体应用注释，也可以对复杂数据类别的概念域作出显式限制。例如，可以明确规定，法语中的/grammaticalGender/只能取{/masculine/、/feminine/}两个值。

原文: This document provides a comprehensive framework for the representation of morphosyntactic annotations (in their simplest form also referred to as “part of speech annotations” or “POS annotations”). This annotation level corresponds to the first lexical abstraction level over language data (textual or spoken) and, depending on the language to be annotated, as well as the characteristics of the annotation tool or annotation scheme that is being used, can vary enormously in structure and complexity.
译文: 本文件为形态句法标注的表示提供全面框架；这类标注最简单的形式也称为“词性标注”或“POS标注”。这一标注层是文本或口语数据之上的第一个词汇抽象层。其结构与复杂程度可能差异极大，取决于被标注的语言，以及所用标注工具或标注方案的特点。

原文:
In order to deal with such complex issues as ambiguity and determinism in morphosyntactic annotation, this document introduces a metamodel that draws a clear distinction between, on the one hand, the level of tokens (representing the surface segmentation of the source) and, on the other, the level of word-forms 


(identifying lexical abstractions associated with groups of tokens). Both these levels can be represented as simple sequences and as local graphs in order to model constructions such as multiple segmentations and ambiguous compounds. Elements of these two levels can enter into any kind of n-to-n relationships.
译文: 为处理形态句法标注中的歧义、确定性等复杂问题，本文件引入一个元模型，明确区分两个层次：词元层表示源数据的表层切分，词形层识别与词元组关联的词汇抽象。两层都可以表示为简单序列，也可以表示为局部图，以建模多种切分和有歧义的复合词等结构。两层元素之间可以建立任意多对多关系。

原文: As linguistic segments (sometimes called “markables” in the literature (see, for instance, Reference $[18]$ )), tokens can be delimited in the source document by means of inline mark-up, or they can be identified remotely (separately from the source document) by means of so-called “stand-off annotations”.
译文: 作为语言片段，词元在文献中有时称为“可标注片段”（例如见参考文献[18]）。它们可以用行内标记在源文档中划定，也可以通过所谓“离位标注”在源文档之外远程标识。

原文: As linguistic abstractions, word-forms can be qualified by various linguistic features characterizing the morphosyntactic properties that are instantiated in the realization of the lexical entry within the annotated text. Such properties can range from the simple identification of a lemma up to an explicit reference to a lexical entry in a dictionary. In most existing applications of morphosyntactic annotation, linguistic properties are expressed by means of so-called “tags”. These codes refer to basic feature structures (see early examples in Reference $[20]$ ). Such codes can also provide morphological information, including its part of speech (e.g. noun, adjective, verb), and features such as number, gender, person, mood or tense.
译文: 词形是一种语言学抽象，可以用各种语言特征来描述。这些特征刻画词条在被标注文本中实现时所具有的形态句法性质，内容可从简单识别词目形式，一直到明确引用辞典中的词条。现有大多数形态句法标注应用都用所谓“标记”表达语言性质；这些代码引用基本特征结构（早期示例见参考文献[20]），也能提供词性（如名词、形容词、动词）以及数、语法性、人称、语气和时态等形态信息。

原文: In keeping with the general modelling strategy of ISO/TC 37, this document provides means of relating morphosyntactic tags expressed as feature structures (conforming to ISO 24610-1) to data categories (conforming to ISO 12620-1). Implementers are encouraged to use external reference taxonomies as described by ISO 12620-2 either directly, or by building on them in defining their own categories (appropriate in the coverage, scope or semantics to the requirements of the given encoding project), in conformity with ISO/TC 37 principles.
译文: 遵循ISO/TC 37的通用建模策略，本文件提供一种办法，将用特征结构表达的形态句法标记（符合ISO 24610-1）关联到数据类别（符合ISO 12620-1）。鼓励实施者遵循ISO/TC 37原则，直接采用ISO 12620-2所述的外部参考分类体系，或在其基础上定义自己的类别，使类别在覆盖面、范围或语义上符合具体编码项目的需要。

原文: Associated to the metamodel, this document also provides a default XML syntax that can be used to serialize annotation models conforming to the morphosyntactic annotation framework (MAF). Since many existing projects are based on the Text Encoding Initiative (TEI) Guidelines, see Reference $[31]$ (particularly in digital humanities, where a proper encoding of textual sources is essential), and since the TEI Guidelines already offer a variety of constructs and mechanisms to cope with many issues relevant to spoken corpora and their annotations (see Reference $[22]$ and ISO 24624), the metamodel provided by this document is serialized as TEI XML. Many word-level annotation mechanisms used in this document elaborate on the proposal of Reference $[23]$ , implemented in the TEI Guidelines.
译文: 与元模型配套，本文件还提供默认XML语法，用于序列化符合形态句法标注框架（MAF）的标注模型。许多现有项目采用文本编码倡议（TEI）指南，尤其是在妥善编码文本资料十分重要的数字人文领域；TEI也已提供多种结构和机制，处理口语语料及其标注中的相关问题（见参考文献[31]、[22]及ISO 24624）。因此，本文件采用TEI XML序列化所提出的元模型，并在已纳入TEI指南的参考文献[23]方案基础上，进一步发展多种词级标注机制。

原文: MAF consists of two parts, referred to as MAF Core (this document) and MAF Lattice (planned as ISO 24611-2).
译文: MAF由两部分组成，分别称为MAF核心（本文件）和MAF词格（计划编号为ISO 24611-2）。

原文: Finally, this document forms the conceptual basis for the development of the ISO 24614 series on word segmentation, whereby all general principles and rules defined in ISO 24614-1, as well as the constraints expressed in additional parts for specific languages, can be understood according to the token versus word-form dichotomy.
译文: 最后，本文件为ISO 24614词切分系列的制定提供概念基础。ISO 24614-1规定的所有通用原则和规则，以及其他部分针对具体语言提出的约束，都可依据词元与词形的二分关系来理解。

原文: Language resource management — Morphosyntactic annotation framework (MAF) —
译文: 语言资源管理——形态句法标注框架（MAF）——

原文: Part 1: Core model
译文: 第1部分：核心模型

原文: This document establishes a framework for the representation of annotations of word-sized units in texts. Such annotations describe tokens, their relationship with lexical units (word-forms), and the relevant morphosyntactic properties. This document proposes a metamodel for morphosyntactic annotation that can be augmented with references to data categories contained in a data category repository conforming to ISO 12620-2. It also defines an XML serialization for morphosyntactic annotations, according to the principles laid out in the TEI Guidelines (see Reference [31]).
译文: 本文件建立一种框架，用于表示文本中词级单位的标注。这些标注描述词元、词元与词汇单位（词形）之间的关系，以及相关形态句法性质。本文件提出形态句法标注元模型，该元模型可通过引用符合ISO 12620-2的数据类别库中的数据类别加以扩充。本文件还按照TEI指南规定的原则，定义形态句法标注的XML序列化方式（见参考文献[31]）。

原文: This document does not apply to structural ambiguities or the structure and composition of morphosyntactic tagsets.
译文: 本文件不适用于结构歧义，也不适用于形态句法标记集的结构与组成。

原文: This document does not address the linguistic choices that identify tokens or determine the language- or context-particular relationships between tokens and word-forms.
译文: 本文件不讨论用于识别词元，或确定特定语言或语境下词元与词形之间关系的语言学选择。

原文: The following documents are referred to in the text in such a way that some or all of their content constitutes requirements of this document. For dated references, only the edition cited applies. For undated references, the latest edition of the referenced document (including any amendments) applies.
译文: 下列文件通过文中的规范性引用，使其部分或全部内容构成本文件的要求。凡注日期的引用文件，仅所注日期的版本适用；凡不注日期的引用文件，其最新版本（包括所有修改单）适用。

译文: ISO和IEC为标准化工作维护术语数据库，地址如下：

原文:
## 3.1

## morphology

description of the structure and formation of words (3.7) 

Note 1 to entry: Morphology is traditionally divided into: 

a) word-formation (3.2), dealing with the formation of complex lexemes (3.6) out of simpler lexemes: by means of derivation (often signalled by affixation, i.e. addition of a morpheme (3.11)) or by means of compounding (combining two or more lexemes); 

b) inflection (3.3) that creates inflected forms (3.4).
译文:
3.1 形态学
关于词（3.7）的结构与形成的描述。
注1：形态学传统上分为：
a) 构词法（3.2）：研究如何由较简单的词位形成复杂词位（3.6），方法包括派生〔通常以词缀附加表现，即添加语素（3.11）〕和复合构词（结合两个或多个词位）；
b) 屈折（3.3）：产生屈折形式（3.4）。

原文:
## 3.2

## word-formation

branch of morphology (3.1), dealing with the creation of new lexemes (3.6) by the processes of derivation or compounding
译文:
3.2 构词法
形态学（3.1）的一个分支，研究通过派生或复合构词过程形成新词位（3.6）。

原文:
## 3.3

## inflection

branch of morphology (3.1), dealing with contextual realizations of lexemes (3.6) as inflected forms (3.4)
译文:
3.3 屈折
形态学（3.1）的一个分支，研究词位（3.6）在语境中实现为屈折形式（3.4）的过程。

原文:
## 3.4

## inflected form

concrete form that a lexeme (3.6) can take when used in a sentence or a phrase
译文:
3.4 屈折形式
词位（3.6）用于句子或短语时可以呈现的具体形式。

原文:
## 3.5

## word-form

abstract instantiation of a lexeme $(3.6)$ with the values of morphosyntactic features $(3.12)$ fixed in a syntactic context 

Note 1 to entry: Word-forms can have no acoustic or graphic realization, or can correspond to one or more tokens (3.21), not necessarily forming a contiguous sequence.
译文:
3.5 词形
词位（3.6）的抽象实例，其形态句法特征（3.12）的取值在句法语境中已经确定。
注1：词形可以没有语音或书写实现，也可以对应一个或多个词元（3.21）；这些词元不必组成连续序列。

原文:
## 3.6

## lexeme

abstract, fundamental unit in the lexicon $(3.10)$ of a language, comprising semantic, formal (phonetic and/or graphemic) and grammatical information 

Note 1 to entry: A complex lexeme is the result of word-formation (3.2) (derivation or compounding) processes; a simple lexeme can be thought of as the base for such processes. In a lexical entry (3.9), a lexeme is identified by a lemma (3.8). Word-forms (3.5) are results of the interaction of lexemes with the grammatical system of the given language.
译文:
3.6 词位
语言词库（3.10）中抽象而基本的单位，包含语义信息、形式信息（语音和/或书写形式）及语法信息。
注1：复杂词位是构词法（3.2）中的派生或复合构词过程的结果，简单词位可视为这些过程的基础。在词条（3.9）中，词位由词目形式（3.8）标识。词形（3.5）是词位与该语言语法系统相互作用的结果。

原文:
## 3.7

## word

lexeme (3.6), word-form (3.5) or token (3.21) 

Note 1 to entry: The term “word” is notoriously ambiguous, standing (at least) for lexeme, word-form or token, depending on the context of its use. This document attempts to disambiguate this term where relevant.
译文:
3.7 词
词位（3.6）、词形（3.5）或词元（3.21）。
注1：“词”是一个公认具有多义性的术语，至少可随语境指词位、词形或词元。本文件在有必要时对这些用法加以区分。

原文:
## 3.8

lemma
base form
canonical form
lemmatized form
conventional form chosen to represent a lexeme (3.6) 

Note 1 to entry: In European languages, the lemma is usually the singular if there is a variation in number, the masculine form if there is a variation in gender, and the infinitive for all verbs. In some languages, certain nouns are defective in the singular form; in these cases, the plural is chosen. For verbs in Arabic, the lemma is usually deemed to be the third person singular with the accomplished aspect. 

Note 2 to entry: The term “lemma” is most often used in the context of corpora, as a device to capture the identity of tokens $(3.21)$ and establish basic correspondence between a token and a lexical entry $(3.9)$ . The term that corresponds to lemma in the context of lexicons $(3.10)$ is “headword”. Mismatches between the two are possible due to the varying macro- and microstructure of lexical entries. In order to handle such mismatches, apart from lemmas, direct references to dictionary entries are sometimes added to tokens or word-forms $(3.5)$ in corpora.
译文:
3.8 词目形式
基本形式
规范形式
词目化形式
按惯例选定、用于代表词位（3.6）的形式。
注1：在欧洲语言中，存在数变化时通常选单数，存在性变化时通常选阳性形式，动词通常选不定式。有些语言中的某些名词没有单数形式，此时选复数。阿拉伯语动词的词目形式通常采用第三人称单数完成体形式。
注2：“lemma”最常用于语料库，作为识别词元（3.21）身份、建立词元与词条（3.9）基本对应关系的手段。在词库（3.10）语境中，与它相应的术语是“词目”。词条的宏观和微观结构各不相同，两者因此可能不匹配。为处理这些不匹配，语料库有时会在词元或词形（3.5）上，除词目形式外再加上对辞典词条的直接引用。

原文:
## 3.9

## lexical entry

container for managing a set of word-forms (3.5) and possibly one or more meanings that describe a lexeme (3.6)
译文:
3.9 词条

## 3.11

## morpheme

exponent that signals a modification of a lexeme (3.6) 

Note 1 to entry: This definition adheres to a lexeme-based approach to morphology (3.1) where it is the lexeme, not the morpheme, that encodes the linguistic sign. On this approach, the morpheme is a unit of form (an exponent) that marks various kinds of modifications (e.g. derivation or inflection (3.3)) of a lexeme. 

Note 2 to entry: Morphemes can usually be divided into derivational and inflectional (signalling a morphosyntactic category). Sometimes a modification of a lexeme is not overtly marked, and sometimes the morpheme is a combined (fused) exponent of various kinds of morphosyntactic information. 

Note 3 to entry: On morpheme-based (as opposed to lexeme-based) approaches, the morpheme is defined as the minimal linguistic sign (a combination of the meaning and the form). On these approaches, the term “morph” is used roughly in the meaning that is used for the term “morpheme” in this document.

标示词位（3.6）发生改变的形式表达单位。
注1：本定义采用词位本位的形态学（3.1）分析方法；在该方法中，承载语言符号的是词位，而非语素。语素是一个形式单位，即形式表达单位，用于标示词位的各种变化，例如派生或屈折（3.3）。
注2：语素通常分为派生语素和屈折语素，后者标示形态句法范畴。有时词位的变化没有显性标记；有时一个语素同时融合表达多种形态句法信息。
注3：语素本位的方法与词位本位的方法不同，它将语素定义为最小语言符号，即意义与形式的结合。在这些方法中，“语素形”（morph）的含义大致对应本文件中“语素”的用法。

原文: 4 MAF metamodel
译文: 4 MAF元模型

原文: 4.1 Levels of description in the MAF metamodel
译文: 4.1 MAF元模型的描述层次

原文: Morphosyntactic annotations provide an important layer of linguistic information in a document. This document is based on a metamodel that draws a clear distinction between two levels of description:
译文: 形态句法标注为文档提供重要的语言信息层。本文件基于一个明确区分以下两个描述层次的元模型：

原文: — the level of tokens (representing the surface segmentation of the source);
译文: — 词元层：表示源数据的表层切分；

原文: — the level of word-forms (identifying lexical abstractions associated with groups of tokens).
译文: — 词形层：识别与词元组关联的词汇抽象。

原文: These two levels have the following property in common: they can be represented as simple sequences and as local graphs (for the purpose of describing, for example, multiple possible segmentations or ambiguous compounds). Any n-to-n relationship can obtain between word-forms and tokens. Word-forms can be aggregated to form maximal units (such as compound words or multi-word units) that act as elementary units for other levels of linguistic analysis, particularly syntax. In particular, word-forms in many cases correspond directly to the terminal level defined in ISO 24615-1.
译文: 这两个层次有一个共同性质：既可表示为简单序列，也可表示为局部图，例如用于描述多种可能切分或有歧义的复合词。词形与词元之间可以存在任意多对多关系。词形还可汇集为最大单位，例如复合词或多词单位，供其他语言分析层次，尤其是句法分析，作为基本单位使用；在许多情形下，词形直接对应ISO 24615-1定义的终端层。

原文: 4.2 MAF in the standards landscape
译文: 4.2 MAF在相关标准体系中的位置

原文: Figure 1 presents a simplified view of the proposed metamodel for morphosyntactic annotations, together with the place of MAF in the context of other standards for language description.
译文: 图1简要展示了所提出的形态句法标注元模型，以及MAF在其他语言描述标准中的位置。

原文: An annotated document comprises an original document and a set of annotations. Annotations are in most cases associated with word-forms, which correspond to zero or more tokens in the original document. A word-form can also be associated with a lexical entry providing information about its underlying lemma and its inflected form(s). The morphosyntactic annotation associated with a word-form is represented by a tag, which can also be expressed as a feature structure. A set of such tags used by a particular annotation scheme is referred to as a “morphosyntactic tagset” and corresponds to what is defined in the ISO 24610-1-specified feature structure representation (FSR) as a feature-structure library. Each discrete category within such a tagset should be describable in terms of data categories as described in ISO 12620-1, and implemented in a centralized repository of data categories conforming to ISO 12620-2. See Annex B for an illustration.
译文: 已标注文档由原始文档和一组标注组成。标注通常关联到词形，而词形对应原始文档中的零个或多个词元；词形还可关联到词条，由词条提供其词目形式及屈折形式的信息。词形上的形态句法标注用标记表示，也可表达为特征结构。某一标注方案采用的一组此类标记称为“形态句法标记集”，对应ISO 24610-1规定的特征结构表示（FSR）中的特征结构库。标记集中的每个离散类别都宜能用ISO 12620-1所述的数据类别描述，并在符合ISO 12620-2的集中式数据类别库中实现。示例见附录B。

原文: 4.3 Metadata
译文: 4.3 元数据

原文: The metadata needed to properly describe language resources can be handled by standards of the CMDI family (CMDI = Component Metadata Infrastructure, see ISO 24622-1 and others) or similar established standards, beyond the mechanisms provided by the TEI, in particular by the set of vocabulary and structural relationships defined for the TEI Header.
译文: 除TEI提供的机制，尤其是TEI头部所定义的词汇和结构关系外，正确描述语言资源所需的元数据还可采用CMDI系列标准或其他类似的成熟标准处理。CMDI即组件元数据基础设施，见ISO 24622-1等标准。

原文: NOTE 1 See Chapter 2 of Reference [31].
译文: 注1：见参考文献[31]第2章。

原文: TEI-external metadata descriptions can even be made part of the TEI Header, by virtue of its <xenoData> element.
译文: 借助`<xenoData>`元素，采用TEI之外格式编写的元数据描述也可以纳入TEI头部。

原文: NOTE 2 See Reference [32].
译文: 注2：见参考文献[32]。

原文: 4.4 Structural ambiguities
译文: 4.4 结构歧义

原文: Because annotation can be applied both to tokens and to word-forms, and given the n-to-n relationship between the elements of both levels, combined annotations can be in structural conflict. Hence, annotation is typically conceptualized as one or more streams, each represented as a word lattice or more formally as a directed acyclic graph (DAG).
译文: 标注既可作用于词元，也可作用于词形，而这两层元素之间又存在多对多关系，因此组合后的标注可能发生结构冲突。为此，通常将标注视为一个或多个流，每个流表示为词格，或更形式化地表示为有向无环图（DAG）。

原文: 4.5 MAF metamodel in detail
译文: 4.5 MAF元模型详述

原文: This subclause presents the MAF metamodel in more detail. The primary focus is on the core model, which describes the relationship between the two levels of description as well as the function and placement of annotations. Word lattices are the focus of ISO 24611-2. The metamodel is diagrammed in Figure 2.
译文: 本条进一步介绍MAF元模型，重点是核心模型。核心模型描述两个层次之间的关系，以及标注的功能与位置；词格则是ISO 24611-2的重点。元模型见图2。

Unless explicitly stated, all constructs serializing the MAF metamodel shall be valid TEI representations, which means that the specification described in this document is a customization of the TEI Guidelines (see Reference [31]; for thorough discussion of the concepts of customization and conformance, see chapter 23 in there). MAF documents shall thus also be well-formed XML documents as specified by the W3C XML Recommendation.

译文: 参考文献[24]提供了用于说明本文件的更新版TEI ODD规范及更多示例。

原文: Morphosyntactic annotations reference segments, called “tokens”, that are present in the document flow, but this does not imply that the resulting segmentation constitutes a sequence of adjacent segments partitioning the original document. Some parts of a document can carry no annotations (e.g. typographic marks, stage directions and markup elements), while other parts do not always correspond exactly to their segmented form (e.g. abbreviations, brachygraphies, orthographic errors and variations, and typographic and morphological contractions).
译文: 形态句法标注引用文档流中的片段，这些片段称为“词元”。但这并不意味着切分结果是一个由相邻片段组成、完整划分原始文档的序列。文档的某些部分可以没有标注，例如排印记号、舞台说明和标记元素；另一些部分则可能与其切分形式不完全一致，例如缩写、简写符号、拼写错误及变体，以及排印或形态上的缩合。

原文: It is particularly important to distinguish word-forms from their realizations. A word-form does not always correspond exactly to a segment delimited solely by orthographic marks such as white spaces or hyphens (e.g. for German compound words, speech transcription, Sanskrit writing).
译文: 尤其需要区分词形及其实现。词形不一定恰好对应一个仅由空格、连字符等正字法标记划定的片段，例如德语复合词、口语转写和梵文书写中的情况。

原文: Table 1 contains a selection of attributes defined for the <seg> element by the TEI Guidelines (see Reference [31]) and by the TEI ODD specification document (see Reference [24]) that customizes the TEI Guidelines for the purpose of serializing the abstract MAF datamodel.
