原文: Many approaches to lightweight grammatical annotation do not apply the full distinction between tokens and word-forms systematically. Instead, realizations of these two annotation layers are squished into a single stream of markup. In this vein, the TEI Guidelines (see Reference [31]) offer an option of encoding tokens by means of <w> ("word") and <pc> ("punctuation character") elements, while at the same time making it possible to encode morphosyntactic and morpholexical information directly in these elements. That should not be seen as "wrong" but rather "pragmatic" or "shorthand" – very often, the token versus word-form mismatches are not significant for the given language or the given data set, and it is more important to provide explicit tokenization with part-of-speech identification, even if some fringe cases are then left to be dealt with, often in ad hoc ways. A representation such as <w pos="verb">go</w><pc pos="punct">!</pc> represents a union of the level of tokens (with two anonymous sequences of characters, "go" and "!") and the level of word-forms, which provides the part-of-speech identification and adds to the anonymous segments the redundant information concerning their status, respectively, as "word" and as a punctuation character. A standard should tease these layers apart and demonstrate how they can be combined for practical reasons, and that is why, in this document, tokens are identified by means of anonymous <seg> elements, agnostic with respect to anything that properly belongs at the word-form level of description.
译文:
许多轻量语法标注方法并未系统地完整区分词元与词形，而是把两层的实现压入单一标记流。沿着这一思路，TEI指南（见参考文献[31]）允许使用`<w>`（“词”）和`<pc>`（“标点字符”）元素编码词元，同时直接在这些元素中编码形态句法和形态词汇信息。这种做法不宜视为“错误”，而宜视为实用做法或简写方式：对许多语言或数据集而言，两层的不匹配并不突出，显式切分并标明词性更为重要，即使仍有一些边缘情形需要另行处理，且往往需按具体情况采取相应办法。
例如，`<w pos="verb">`go`</w>``<pc pos="punct">`!`</pc>`合并了两个层次：词元层提供“go”和“!”两个未赋予语言类别的字符序列，词形层提供词性信息，并向这两个片段补充它们分别是“词”和“标点字符”这一冗余信息。标准宜先厘清这两层，再展示如何为实际用途合并使用。因此，本文件用不预设语言类别的`<seg>`元素标识词元，不在该层承担本应属于词形层的信息。

译文: 5.3 嵌入式表示法

原文: Although this sequential variant of embedded notation is used for most of the examples provided by MAF, it can pose problems in certain circumstances, for example where the treatment of white space characters in XML has not been properly taken into account, or – more significantly – in the presence of other, conflicting hierarchies. In such circumstances, stand-off notation provides a clean solution.
译文: MAF的大多数示例采用这种顺序排列的嵌入式表示法，但它在某些情形下可能产生问题，例如未充分考虑XML空白字符的处理，更重要的是同时存在其他相互冲突的层级。此时可以用离位表示法妥善解决。

原文: 5.4 Stand-off notation
译文: 5.4 离位表示法

原文: a) to identify the character sequences that are to serve as tokens;
译文: a) 识别用作词元的字符序列；

原文: b) to furnish them with unique identifiers, so that they can be referenced from other annotation layers.
译文: b) 为这些序列提供唯一标识符，使其他标注层可以引用它们。

原文: Figure 5 — Stand-off tokenization
译文: 图5——离位词元切分

原文: The offsets provided by the @startPos and @endPos attributes require an explicit basis for the calculations. In general, in TEI XML, a structure such as that shown in Figure 6 can be used, where the running text is located within the TEI <text> element, while the pointing is done from within a <standOff> element.
译文: `@startPos`和`@endPos`给出的偏移量必须有明确的计算基准。TEI XML通常可采用图6所示结构：正文位于TEI的`<text>`元素中，引用则从`<standOff>`元素内部发出。

原文: Figure 6 — Stand-off annotation in compliance with the MAF customization of the TEI guidelines
译文: 图6——符合TEI指南MAF定制的离位标注

原文: In Figure 6, several critical parts of a TEI document are shown: the obligatory <teiHeader>, the optional <text> element, and the optional <standOff> element, where <listAnnotation> lists all the annotations pertaining to a specific part of the text (here: a single sentence), and a typed <annotationBlock> encodes annotation layers (here: the level of tokens and the level of word-forms, to be discussed below). The @corresp attribute ensures explicit correspondence between the <listAnnotation> element and the sentence whose contents are being annotated, and the @target attribute encodes the relationship between the <span> elements and the tokens that represent the given word-form. The fact that the <text> element is optional makes it possible to create documents that contain stand-off annotations alone (if, for example, the source text is write-protected). In such cases, the pointing attributes shall contain full URIs rather than merely fragment identifiers. Given the assumed XML serialization, the @xml:base attribute can be used to hold part of the target URI.

图6展示了TEI文档的若干关键部分：必需的`<teiHeader>`、可选的`<text>`，以及可选的`<standOff>`。其中，`<listAnnotation>`汇集某一文本部分（此处为一个句子）的全部标注，带类型的`<annotationBlock>`则编码各标注层（此处为词元层及下文讨论的词形层）。`@corresp`明确建立`<listAnnotation>`与被标注句子的对应，`@target`表示`<span>`与实现该词形的词元之间的关系。

原文: 5.5 Normalization and script conversion
译文: 5.5 规范化和文字体系转换

原文: Tokens identify segments of the original document, either by enclosing them or by pointing to them in a stand-off manner, through the specification of a start and end point within the character stream that the document consists of. It is also often useful to associate with each token some additional abstract information, for instance concerning its graphical or phonological variations, even if they are not immediately relevant to the project at hand. The non-mandatory attributes @norm, @phon and @translit can be used to perform such abstraction.
译文: 词元通过两种方式标识原始文档中的片段：直接包围片段，或指定文档字符流中的起点和终点，以离位方式引用片段。为每个词元补充一些抽象信息通常也有用，例如其书写或音系变体，即使这些信息与当前项目并无直接关系。可选属性`@norm`、`@phon`和`@translit`可用于提供这类抽象信息。

原文: These attributes are typically used to provide a preferred normalization in the presence, for example, of variations, a phonetic transcription or a transliteration into some other writing system. See Figures 7 and 8.
译文: 这些属性通常用于在存在变体时给出优选的规范形式，或提供语音转写、转字为其他书写系统的形式。见图7和图8。

原文: Figure 7 — Usage examples of the normalization and script conversion attributes
译文: 图7——规范化和文字体系转换属性的使用示例

原文: Figure 8 — Further usage examples of attributes assisting in the identification of script variants, providing information on transliteration, general transcription, phonetic transcription and normalization
译文: 图8——辅助识别文字体系变体的属性的其他使用示例，提供转字、一般转写、语音转写和规范化信息

原文: The abstraction provided by the @norm attribute is also appropriate for dealing with the phenomena of contraction and agglutination, where two tokens can cover the same segment of the original document while having distinct values (on overlapping tokens, see 5.6.3).
译文: `@norm`属性提供的抽象信息也适用于缩合和黏合现象：两个词元可以覆盖原始文档中的同一片段，却具有不同的值。关于重叠词元，见5.6.3。

原文: 5.6 Inline token annotation strategies for token separation
译文: 5.6 用于分隔词元的行内标注策略

原文: 5.6.1 General remarks

As mentioned above, inline token notation is less precise than stand-off notation, in particular because it does not make the contiguity and overlapping of tokens fully explicit. In the absence of strict conventions for the interpretation of the embedded token notation, more precise identification of segments is possible using document positions, as in the case of stand-off notation. This subclause introduces strategies to separate a contiguous and also overlapping sequence of tokens in cases where the stand-off approach is not an option.
译文: 如上所述，行内词元表示法不如离位表示法精确，尤其不能充分显式表达词元的连续相接和重叠关系。如果没有严格约定嵌入式词元表示法的解释方式，就可像离位表示法那样，利用文档位置更精确地识别片段。本条介绍在无法采用离位方式时，如何分隔连续相接或彼此重叠的词元序列。

原文: 5.6.2 Adjacent tokens in embedded mode
译文: 5.6.2 嵌入模式中的相邻词元

原文: By convention, two sibling tokens are considered to be separated by whatever separator is standard for the document language, for instance, a space. This convention can be modified by using the @join attribute to specify how a token is joined to its sibling tokens. The attribute @join takes the value “prev” (for “previous”, see Figure 9) or “next” to indicate that a token is contiguous with its preceding and following siblings respectively, rather than separated from them. The values “prev” and “next” are meant to be agnostic with respect to text directionality.
译文: 按照约定，两个同级词元之间视为存在该文档语言通常使用的分隔符，例如空格。可用`@join`改变这一约定，说明某词元如何与同级词元相接。`@join`取“prev”（previous，即前一个，见图9）或“next”时，分别表示与前一个或后一个同级词元连续相接，而非被分隔。prev和next的含义不取决于文字的书写方向。

原文: Figure 9 — Example tokenization of L'on dit (fr - "it is said ...")
译文: 图9——L'on dit的词元切分示例（法语：“据说……”）

原文: The value “both” is used to show that a token is contiguous with both left and right siblings, as can be the case if it encloses material usually considered as separator, such as spaces, newline, dash or apostrophe (see Figure 10).
译文: “both”表示一个词元与左右两侧的同级词元都连续相接。当该词元包围通常被视为分隔符的材料，例如空格、换行、破折号或撇号时，就可能采用这种方式，见图10。

原文: NOTE The value “both” of the attribute @join signals that the token in question is directly adjacent to its neighbouring tokens.
译文: 注：`@join`取值“both”，表示该词元与两侧相邻词元都直接相接。

译文: 图10——L'on dit的彻底细分式词元切分（法语：“据说……”）

原文: 5.6.3 Overlapping tokens
译文: 5.6.3 重叠词元

原文: Two tokens can overlap, for instance to denote an agglutinated or contracted form. In such cases, a <seg> marks the realization of a typographical or vocal sequence, and also expresses a deeper linguistic reality relevant for segmenting a document. However, it is more usual to disregard the overlap at the token level of analysis and to handle the issue at the level of linguistic analysis (involving word-forms) as discussed in Clause 6.
译文: 两个词元可以重叠，例如用于表示黏合或缩合形式。在这种情形下，`<seg>`既标识某一书写或语音序列的实现，也表达与文档切分有关的更深层语言学事实。不过，更常见的做法是在词元分析层忽略重叠，把问题交由涉及词形的语言分析层处理，见第6章。

原文: For instance, in the contracted form “etc.”, the dot can be seen as a token that overlaps: it is used both within the abbreviation and as a punctuation mark. This can be encoded by means of the stand-off approach as shown in Figure 12.
译文: 例如，在缩合形式“etc.”中，句点可以看作一个重叠词元：它既是缩写的一部分，也作为标点使用。这可用图12所示的离位方式编码。

原文: 6 Word-forms as linguistic units
译文: 6 作为语言单位的词形

原文: 6.1 General remarks
译文: 6.1 概述

原文: The tokens identified by <seg> elements correspond in some way to word-forms encoded as <span> elements. A word-form can be associated with a lexical entry in a lexicon using the @lemmaRef attribute (see 6.2). It can also be characterized by part-of-speech information that expresses morphological and grammatical properties as a feature structure (see 7.2). Information about the lemma and inflected forms can also be provided, using the @lemma and @norm attributes. In particular, the @norm attribute is useful when the inflected form attached to the word-form does not coincide with the content of the <seg> element, for instance because of spelling corrections.
译文: 由`<seg>`元素标识的词元，以某种方式对应于由`<span>`元素编码的词形。词形可以用`@lemmaRef`关联到词库中的词条（见6.2），也可以用词性信息加以描述；这些信息以特征结构的形式表达形态和语法性质（见7.2）。`@lemma`和`@norm`还可分别提供词目形式及屈折形式的信息。尤其在拼写订正等情况下，如果词形所附的屈折形式与`<seg>`内容不同，`@norm`就很有用。

原文: A token can be associated with more than one word-form and, conversely, a word-form can represent more than one token. The @target attribute is used to associate a <span> element with one or more <seg> elements. The association is represented by means of a pointer, typically referencing an @xml:id attribute present on one or more <seg> elements.
译文: 一个词元可以关联多个词形；反过来，一个词形也可以表示多个词元。`@target`将一个`<span>`元素关联到一个或多个`<seg>`元素，通常通过指针引用这些`<seg>`上的`@xml:id`。

原文: For instance, in French, the morphological agglutination of auquel (“to which”) can have several representations, depending on the granularity of the tokenization.
译文: 例如，法语中的形态黏合形式auquel（“向哪个／向其”）可有多种表示，取决于词元切分的粒度。

原文: When the priority is put on coarse granularity, the character sequence auquel is not decomposed and corresponds to a single token, but there are two different word-forms associated with this single token. That is encoded as shown in Figure 13.
译文: 采用粗粒度时，不分解字符序列auquel，将其作为一个词元，但让两个不同词形关联到这同一个词元。编码见图13。

原文: NOTE The @ana attribute holds a pointer to a feature structure.
译文: 注：`@ana`属性保存指向特征结构的指针。

译文: 图13——auquel的粗粒度编码（法语：“向哪个／向其”）

原文: A sequence of non-contiguous tokens can also be associated with a single word-form, for instance to handle cases where some material is inserted inside the components of a word-form, as shown in Figure 17.
译文: 一组不连续词元也可以关联到单个词形，例如用于处理词形各组成部分之间插入其他材料的情形，见图17。

原文: Figure 17 — Discontinuous tokens: afin justement de (fr - “precisely in order to”), where “afin ... de” is the discontinuous sequence
译文: 图17——不连续词元afin justement de（法语：“恰恰为了”），其中afin ... de是不连续序列

原文: This kind of phenomenon can also occur with verbs with detached particles, for instance in English or German. The English infinitive verbal form (to + <verb>) can also fall into this scheme (see Figure 18).
译文: 这类现象也可见于带分离小品词的动词，例如英语或德语动词。英语动词不定式（to + `<verb>`）也可采用这种表示，见图18。

原文: Figure 18 — Discontinuous tokens: “to ... go” are often considered to form a single morphosyntactic entity (the infinitive of go)
译文: 图18——不连续词元：“to ... go”常被视为单一形态句法实体，即go的不定式

原文: In order to identify discontinuous word-forms while preserving some information about the position of each component in the flow of word-forms, multiple word-forms can reference the same sequence of tokens and refer to the same entry (and possibly sub-entries), as in Figure 19.
译文: 为标识不连续词形，并保留各组成部分在词形流中的一些位置信息，可以让多个词形引用同一词元序列，同时引用同一词条及可能的子词条，如图19所示。

原文: Figure 19 — Discontinuous tokens with lexical references
译文: 图19——带词汇引用的不连续词元

原文: 6.3.4 Zero token: one word-form
译文: 6.3.4 零个词元：一个词形

原文: Another case that can arise is when it is desirable to insert a word-form that is not realized in the original document and that is therefore associated with an empty sequence of tokens. Use cases include some pronouns in Spanish, and the hypothesis of traces in movement-based analyses of syntactic dislocation. This kind of annotation practice is highly dependent on the linguistic assumptions of the given project. In Figure 20, the relative position of the pronoun is determined by theoretical assumptions concerning sentence structure, where the unrealized pronoun PRO is taken to function as the counterpart of a lexically realized sentential subject.
译文: 另一种情形是需要插入一个在原始文档中没有实现的词形，因此让它关联到空词元序列。用途包括西班牙语中的某些代词，以及基于移位分析句法错位时假定的语迹。这类标注高度依赖具体项目的语言学假设。在图20中，代词的相对位置由句子结构理论决定，未实现的代词PRO被视为与词汇上实际实现的句子主语相对应的成分。

原文: Figure 20 — Word-form with no surface realization: Jean propose de PRO partir (fr – “Jean proposes PRO to leave”), where PRO is a phonetically unrealised pronominal form
译文: 图20——没有表层实现的词形：Jean propose de PRO partir（法语：“Jean提议PRO离开”），其中PRO是未在语音中实现的代词形式

原文: 6.3.5 One token: several word-forms
译文: 6.3.5 一个词元：多个词形

原文: Finally, several word-forms can be merged into the same token, as illustrated by the examples shown in Figures 21 and 22.
译文: 最后，多个词形也可能合并在同一个词元中，示例见图21和图22。

原文: Figure 21 — Multiple word-forms in dammelo (it - “Give it to me”)
译文: 图21——dammelo中的多个词形（意大利语：“把它给我”）

原文: Figure 22 — Multiple word-forms corresponding to a single token in auquel (fr - “to which”)
译文: 图22——auquel中对应单个词元的多个词形（法语：“向哪个／向其”）

原文: 6.4 Referencing lexical entries
译文: 6.4 引用词条

原文: Figure 23 — Simple reference to a lexical entry
译文: 图23——对词条的简单引用

原文: Depending on the editorial environment of the corresponding digital lexicon, entries can be referred to by means of a URN (as exemplified in Figure 23) or, when applicable, by a full URI that directly points to the corresponding entry (as in Figure 8). It is also possible to refer to lexical “sub-entries” for polysemous entries or for compound forms. See Figure 24, which assumes that the entry for “decide” has subparts identified by “to” and “main”.
译文: 依据数字词库的编辑环境，可以通过URN引用词条，如图23；在适用时，也可使用直接指向词条的完整URI，如图8。对于多义词条或复合形式，还可引用词汇“子词条”。图24假定decide词条包含分别由to和main标识的子部分。

原文: Figure 24 — Complex reference to multiple lexical entries
译文: 图24——对多个词条的复合引用

原文: A token or a sequence of tokens can sometimes be identified as corresponding to a word-form but cannot be associated with any lexical entry, perhaps because no lexicon is available, or because the word-form corresponds to a named entity (e.g. a proper name, date or address) or because the word-form is a neologism. In that case, the @lemmaRef attribute can be omitted. The other informative attributes @lemma and @norm can still be used to provide information about the word-form. See Figure 25.
译文: 有时可以确定一个词元或词元序列对应某个词形，却无法把它关联到任何词条。原因可能是没有可用词库、该词形对应命名实体（例如专名、日期或地址），或该词形是新词。此时可省略`@lemmaRef`，仍可用`@lemma`和`@norm`提供词形信息，见图25。

原文: Figure 25 — Sequence of tokens corresponding to a single word-form (a date) without a dictionary representation
译文: 图25——与单个词形（日期）对应的词元序列，该词形在辞典中没有对应表示

原文: In a production system, such unknown words can be collected in an additional document-specific lexicon, which can then be referenced in the same way.
译文: 在实际运行的系统中，可以把这些未收录词汇集到一个文档专用的补充词库中，再用同样方式引用。

原文: 6.5 Compound word-forms
译文: 6.5 复合词形

原文: The structure of compound forms (including multi-word expressions) can be expressed using nested wordforms, thus providing information about the subparts even when no information is available for the whole, for instance for neologisms (see Figure 26).
译文: 复合形式（包括多词表达）的结构可用嵌套词形表示。这样，即使尚无整体信息，例如遇到新词时，也能提供其子部分的信息，见图26。

原文: Figure 26 — Representing compounds: Geburtstagsgeschenkpapier (de - “birthday gift wrapping paper”)
译文: 图26——表示复合词：Geburtstagsgeschenkpapier（德语：“生日礼物包装纸”）

原文: The definition of compounding or derivational morphology is outside the scope of this document.
译文: 本文件不定义复合构词或派生形态学。

原文: 6.6 Identification of word-forms
译文: 6.6 词形的标识

原文: The word-form component of the MAF metamodel should be implemented by means of a <span> element, subject to the following constraints:
译文: MAF元模型的词形组件宜用`<span>`元素实现，并遵守以下约束：

原文: — <span> elements can be grouped together within one or more <spanGrp> elements;
译文: — `<span>`元素可以汇集在一个或多个`<spanGrp>`中；

原文: — the @target attribute should contain the list of URIs which reference the tokens that the word-form is associated with;
译文: — `@target`宜包含一个URI列表，引用与该词形关联的词元；

原文: — the @lemmaRef attribute can be used to point to a lexical entry (or a subpart of an entry);
译文: — `@lemmaRef`可用于指向词条或词条的某个子部分；

原文: — the @ana attribute can be used to point to a feature structure (or a feature-value library entry, see below) that provides the morphosyntactic content of the word-form.
译文: — `@ana`可用于指向提供该词形形态句法内容的特征结构，或特征值库中的条目，见下文。

原文: See Annex A for further examples. See Clause 9 for the complete conformance criteria of MAF.
译文: 更多示例见附录A。MAF完整的符合性准则见第9章。

原文: 7 Morphosyntactic content
译文: 7 形态句法内容

原文: 7.1 General remarks
译文: 7.1 概述

原文: This clause shows how to attach morphosyntactic content to word-forms, how to define reusable morphosyntactic tagsets in order to provide compact notations by means of tags, and how to control the validity of such tags.
译文: 本章说明如何把形态句法内容附加到词形，如何定义可复用的形态句法标记集以提供紧凑标记表示，以及如何控制这些标记的有效性。

原文: A set of morphosyntactic features and their possible values, usually referred to as a “morphosyntactic tagset”, specifies the range of possible annotation content. The diversity of approaches and languages makes the definition of any single universally applicable tagset almost impossible. In this context, this document briefly presents mechanisms for defining tagsets by using a data category repository (DCR, see ISO 12620-2) and feature structures (FSR, see ISO 24610-1).
译文: 一组形态句法特征及其可能取值，通常称为“形态句法标记集”，规定标注内容的可能范围。由于分析方法和语言各不相同，几乎无法定义一个普遍适用的标记集。因此，本文件简要介绍利用数据类别库（DCR，见ISO 12620-2）和特征结构（FSR，见ISO 24610-1）定义标记集的机制。

原文: An annotated document should include or reference a tagset defining the content of its annotations.
译文: 已标注文档宜包含或引用一个标记集，以定义其标注内容。

原文: Morphosyntactic information added to word-forms shall follow ISO 24610-1 (FSR) either directly or indirectly. The direct relationship shall be implemented either by embedding <fs> elements inside <span> elements (see 7.2) or by providing references to previously defined FSR content. The latter references shall be expressed as values of @ana attributes (see 7.3).
译文: 附加到词形的形态句法信息应直接或间接遵循ISO 24610-1（FSR）。直接方式应通过在`<span>`中嵌入`<fs>`（见7.2），或引用预先定义的FSR内容来实现。后一种引用应作为`@ana`属性的值表达，见7.3。

原文: Morphosyntactic information can also be provided indirectly, via specialized attributes such as @pos, @msd or @lemma (see 6.2). This indirect way is a convenience mapping of relationships defined by ISO 24610-1. For example, fragment @pos="N" is a convenience shorthand that expresses information defined by <f name="pos"><symbol value="noun"/></f>, which is part of a library of morphosyntactic feature structures.
译文: 也可通过`@pos`、`@msd`或`@lemma`等专门属性间接提供形态句法信息，见6.2。这种方式是对ISO 24610-1规定关系的简便映射。例如，`@pos`="N"是简写，它表达的信息由`<f name="pos">``<symbol value="noun"/>``</f>`定义，后者是形态句法特征结构库的一部分。

原文: 7.2 Using feature structures
译文: 7.2 使用特征结构

原文: A <span> element can be provided with morphosyntactic content that defines its linguistic nature and its grammatical function in the current context. Such content shall be expressed using feature structures, following ISO 24610-1. A feature structure can attach one or more (possibly complex) values to linguistic properties (for instance, “noun” to /part of speech/, “present” to /tense/, and “indicative” to /mood/). See Figure 27.
译文: 可为`<span>`提供形态句法内容，以确定它的语言学性质及在当前语境中的语法功能。这些内容应遵循ISO 24610-1，以特征结构表达。特征结构可向语言属性赋予一个或多个值，值也可以是复杂的，例如向/part of speech/赋“名词”，向/tense/赋“现在时”，向/mood/赋“直陈式”，见图27。

原文: Figure 27 — Feature structure-based annotation for belle (fr - “beautiful”)
译文: 图27——belle的特征结构标注（法语：“美丽的”）

原文: The feature structure content attached to a word-form can provide a wide range of additional information of interest about a word-form.
译文: 附加到词形的特征结构可以提供多种有关该词形的其他信息。

原文: 7.3 Compact morphosyntactic tags
译文: 7.3 紧凑形态句法标记

原文: ISO 24610-1 addresses the compact representation of feature structures based on libraries that assign names to feature values and feature specifications (feature-value pairs). These names can be used by the @ana attribute on the <span> element to simplify the tagging, following standard practice in the natural language processing community (see Figure 28).
译文: ISO 24610-1规定了基于库的特征结构紧凑表示方式。库为特征值和特征赋值（特征—值对）分配名称，`<span>`的`@ana`可使用这些名称简化标注，符合自然语言处理领域的通行做法，见图28。

原文: Figure 28 — Morphosyntactic annotation for belle (fr - “pretty”) using the @ana attribute
译文: 图28——使用@ana属性标注belle的形态句法信息（法语：“漂亮的”）

原文: The value of the @ana attribute is syntactically identical to the value of the @feats attribute defined in ISO 24610-2:2011, namely a space-separated sequence of feature specification URIs.
译文: `@ana`的值在语法上与ISO 24610-2:2011定义的`@feats`相同，均为用空格分隔的特征赋值URI序列。

原文: The libraries where recurrent values and feature specifications are defined constitute the morphosyntactic tagset(s) supplied with, or referenced by, the annotated document.
译文: 定义重复使用的特征值和特征赋值的库，构成已标注文档所附带或引用的形态句法标记集。

原文: 7.4 FSR libraries
译文: 7.4 FSR库

原文: The generic library mechanism provided by FSR is illustrated by Figures 29 and 30, showing, respectively, the way to store feature values legal in the given description, and selected legal feature-value pairs.
译文: 图29和图30展示了FSR提供的通用库机制，分别说明如何保存当前描述中允许的特征值，以及选定的合法特征—值对。

原文: Figure 29 — A feature-value library
译文: 图29——特征值库

原文: Figure 30 — A feature specification library
译文: 图30——特征赋值库

原文: It is recommended that the @datcat and @valueDatcat attributes on the corresponding <f> elements should be used to link features declared in the FSR library, or an FSD (feature system declaration) to the appropriate data category references. See Annex B.
译文: 建议在相应`<f>`元素上使用`@datcat`和`@valueDatcat`，将FSR库或FSD（特征系统声明）中声明的特征关联到适当的数据类别引用，见附录B。

原文: The two libraries can be the basis for morphosyntactic annotations as exemplified in Figure 31.
译文: 这两个库可作为形态句法标注的基础，示例见图31。

原文: Figure 32 — Fragmentary feature-value and feature specification libraries
译文: 图32——部分特征值库和特征赋值库

原文: 7.5 Designing morphosyntactic tagsets
译文: 7.5 设计形态句法标记集

原文: The features, values and, possibly, feature types used to specify morphosyntactic content are not simply labels, they also carry linguistic meanings or, to put it another way, semantic content. To avoid misinterpretation or incoherence, the semantic content attached to a feature, value or type should be clearly defined. The combination of features, values and types should also be controlled in order to avoid linguistically invalid combinations, such as using “neuter” as a value for “gender” in French, or using a “tense” feature for nouns.
译文: 用于规定形态句法内容的特征、值及可能使用的特征类型，不只是标签，也承载语言学含义，即语义内容。为避免误解或不一致，宜明确界定每个特征、值和类型的语义，并控制其组合，以避免语言学上无效的组合，例如在法语中把“中性”作为“性”的值，或为名词使用“时态”特征。

原文: This document does not provide the semantic content for all such features, values and types. That would be almost impossible, given the diversity of languages, and it would be equally impossible to assign to each component a meaning that the entire community agrees on.
译文: 本文件不为所有这些特征、值和类型规定语义内容。语言如此多样，几乎不可能完成这项工作，也不可能为每个组件指定一个整个领域都认可的含义。

原文: Instead, it is proposed that an annotated document should be completed by including or referencing one or more tagsets. This document assumes that tagsets are collections of labels that in turn typically reference features or feature structures. For the purpose of this document, the individual tags in a tagset shall be uniquely referenceable. In the default TEI XML serialization of the MAF standard, this means that the tags should be addressable by URIs (either in the full form or via XML fragment identifiers).
译文: 因此，建议通过包含或引用一个或多个标记集来补全已标注文档。本文件将标记集视为标签的集合，这些标签通常进一步引用特征或特征结构。标记集中的每个标记都应能被唯一引用；在MAF默认TEI XML序列化中，这意味着宜能通过完整URI或XML片段标识符定位每个标记。

原文: There are three objectives of a morphosyntactic tagset, as follows:
译文: 形态句法标记集有以下三个目标：

原文: b) To specify the set of valid feature structures based on the selected data categories. This is achieved by means of the ISO 24610-2-specified FSD.
译文: b) 根据选定的数据类别，规定有效特征结构的集合。这通过ISO 24610-2规定的FSD实现。

原文: c) To name the most common morphosyntactic structures through the use of FSR libraries.
译文: c) 利用FSR库为最常见的形态句法结构命名。

原文: 8 Handling ambiguities
译文: 8 歧义处理

原文: 8.1 General
译文: 8.1 概述

原文: Ambiguities arise naturally when describing natural language, especially in the case of automatically produced annotations. They can also occur at various levels of description, and therefore this document proposes several alternatives to handle ambiguities in the word-form content. Other types of ambiguities are the focus of ISO 24611-2.
译文: 描述自然语言时自然会出现歧义，尤其是在自动生成的标注中。歧义也可能出现在不同描述层次，因此本文件提出多种处理词形内容歧义的办法。其他类型歧义是ISO 24611-2的重点。

原文: 8.2 Word-form content ambiguities
译文: 8.2 词形内容歧义

原文: ISO 24610-1:2006 provides several ways of representing ambiguities, for instance at the level of feature values. These mechanisms can be used to handle ambiguities occurring within the morphosyntactic content of a word-form.
译文: ISO 24610-1:2006提供多种歧义表示方式，例如在特征值层面表示歧义。这些机制可用于处理词形形态句法内容中的歧义。

原文: For example, the French inflected verb form mange (“eat”) is ambiguous between the first person and third person singular. This ambiguity can be captured by the <vAlt> element provided by FSR, see Figure 33.
译文: 例如，法语屈折动词形式mange（“吃”）可以是第一人称单数，也可以是第三人称单数。FSR提供的`<vAlt>`可表示这一歧义，见图33。

原文: NOTE Singular present indicative forms are ambiguous between the first and the third person reading.
译文: 注：现在时直陈式单数形式可有第一人称或第三人称两种解读。

原文: Figure 33 — Person ambiguity in the description of a word-form: mange (fr - “eat”)
译文: 图33——词形描述中的人称歧义：mange（法语：“吃”）

原文: A compact tag notation can still be used by registering the most frequent cases of ambiguities in FSR libraries (7.4). See Figure 34.
译文: 通过在FSR库中登记最常见的歧义情形，仍可采用紧凑标记表示法，见7.4及图34。

原文: Figure 34 — Compact tag for mange (fr. "eat"), preserving the ambiguity
译文: 图34——保留歧义的mange紧凑标记（法语：“吃”）

原文: 8.3 Lexical and structural ambiguities
译文: 8.3 词汇和结构歧义

原文: While a lot of cases of ambiguity can be localized under a single <seg> or <span> element and handled by feature-structure mechanisms, ISO 24611-2 will make it possible to employ for that purpose the mechanisms of finite state automata (FSA), and in particular DAGs whose edges are labelled by tokens or word-forms.
译文: 许多歧义可以局限在单个`<seg>`或`<span>`中，并用特征结构机制处理。ISO 24611-2还将允许采用有限状态自动机（FSA）机制，尤其是边上标有词元或词形的有向无环图（DAG），来处理歧义。

原文: 9 Conformance
译文: 9 符合性

原文: Conformance of an annotation scheme with this document is primarily conditioned on sharing the same data model (see 4.5).
译文: 标注方案是否符合本文件，主要取决于它是否采用相同的数据模型，见4.5。

原文: An annotation scheme qualifies as fully conformant with ISO MAF if:
译文: 标注方案满足以下条件时，可认定其完全符合ISO MAF：

原文: — it follows the data model defined by this document; and
译文: — 遵循本文件定义的数据模型；并且

原文: — its serialization is valid with respect to the RELAX NG schema (RNG, RNC, see ISO/IEC 19757-2) or the XML Schema (XSD) defined by the TEI ODD that accompanies this document.
译文: — 其序列化表示符合本文件随附TEI ODD所定义的RELAX NG模式（RNG、RNC，见ISO/IEC 19757-2）或XML Schema（XSD）。

原文: NOTE RELAX NG (REgular Language for XML for Next Generation, ISO/IEC 19757-2) is a schema language for XML, which simplifies and extends the features of document type definitions (DTDs).
译文: 注：RELAX NG（REgular Language for XML for Next Generation，ISO/IEC 19757-2）是XML模式语言，对文档类型定义（DTD）的功能进行了简化和扩展。

原文: An annotation scheme qualifies as algorithmically conformant with ISO MAF if all the following items are true:
译文: 标注方案满足以下全部条件时，可认定其在算法上符合ISO MAF：

原文: — the annotation scheme in question follows the data model defined by this document;
译文: — 该标注方案遵循本文件定义的数据模型；

原文: — its serialization format can be translated into a format that is valid with respect to the Relax NG schema (RNG, RNC) or the XML Schema (XSD) defined by the TEI ODD that implements the principles defined in this document and thereby illustrates it (see Reference [24]);
译文: — 其序列化格式可以转换为符合RELAX NG模式（RNG、RNC）或XML Schema（XSD）的格式。这些模式由TEI ODD定义；该ODD实现本文件所规定的原则，并据此对本文件加以说明（见参考文献[24]）；

原文: — a translation tool to the ISO MAF serialization is provided and potential differences in information content of the two serialization formats are documented.
译文: — 提供将其转换为ISO MAF序列化形式的工具，并记录两种序列化格式在信息内容上可能存在的差异。

原文: B.3 Examples of use

原文: The example in Figure B.1 presents the TEI encoding of the name-value pair <part of speech, common noun>, where the name (key) "part of speech" is abbreviated as "POS", and the value "common noun" is symbolized by "NN". The entire name-value pair is encoded by means of the element <f>. In TEI XML, that element acts as the container, labelled with the name attribute. Its contents can be complex or simple. In the case at hand, the content is the symbol "NN".
译文: 图B.1展示名称—值对〈词性，普通名词〉的TEI编码，其中名称（键）“part of speech”缩写为“POS”，值“common noun”用“NN”表示。整个名称—值对由`<f>`编码；在TEI XML中，`<f>`充当容器，并用name属性标明名称。其内容可以复杂，也可以简单；本例的内容是符号“NN”。

原文: The @datcat attribute relates the feature name (i.e. the key) to the data category "part of speech", while the attribute @valueDatcat relates the feature value to the data category "common noun". Both these data categories should be defined in an external and preferably open reference taxonomy or ontology.
译文: `@datcat`将特征名（即键）关联到“词性”数据类别，`@valueDatcat`则将特征值关联到“普通名词”数据类别。这两个类别都宜在外部参考分类体系或本体中定义，并以开放资源为佳。

原文: Figure B.1 — TEI encoding of the name-value pair <part of speech, common noun>
译文: 图B.1——名称—值对〈词性，普通名词〉的TEI编码

原文: “NN” is the symbol for common noun used, e.g. in the CLAWS-7 tagset (see Reference $[28]$ ) defined by the University Centre for Computer Corpus Research on Language at the University of Lancaster. The very same data category used for tagging an early version of the British National Corpus, and coming from the BNC Basic (C5) tagset (see Reference $[27]$ ), uses the symbol “NN0” (rather than “NN”). Making these values semantically interoperable would be extremely difficult without a human expert if they were not anchored in a single point of an established reference taxonomy of morphosyntactic data categories. In the case at hand, the string "http://hdl.handle.net/11459/CCR_C-1256_7ec6083c-23d4-224d-6f94-eecbe6861545" is both a persistent identifier of the data category in question, as well as a pointer to a shared definition of common noun.
译文:
“NN”是普通名词的符号，例如英国兰卡斯特大学语言计算机语料库研究中心制定的CLAWS-7标记集采用这一符号，见参考文献[28]。同一数据类别在英国国家语料库早期版本采用的BNC Basic（C5）标记集中用“NN0”表示，见参考文献[27]。
如果不把这些值锚定到既定形态句法数据类别参考分类体系中的同一概念，缺少人工专家时很难实现它们的语义互操作。本例中的“http://hdl.handle.net/11459/CCR_C-1256_7ec6083c-23d4-224d-6f94-eecbe6861545”既是该数据类别的持久标识符，也是指向普通名词共享定义的指针。

原文: The TEI Guidelines (see Reference $[31]$ ) do not prescribe a specific choice between datcat and valueDatcat in such cases. The former is the generic way of referencing a data category, whereas the latter is more specific, in that it references a data category that represents a value. The choice between them comes into play where a single element (or a tight element complex, such as the f/symbol complex illustrated above) make it necessary or useful to distinguish between the container data category and its value.
译文: TEI指南没有在这类情形下强制选择datcat或valueDatcat，见参考文献[31]。datcat是引用数据类别的通用方式；valueDatcat更具体，专门引用表示值的数据类别。当一个元素或紧密组合的元素组（如上例f/symbol组合）使区分容器数据类别与其值成为必要或有益的做法时，二者的选择便具有实际意义。

原文: 4 General requirements
译文: 4 总体要求

原文: This document aims at providing constructs for each LMF class from ISO 24613-1 (core model), ISO 24613-2 (MRD extension), and ISO 24613-3 (etymological extension). It requires compliance with ISO 24613-1, ISO 24613-2, and ISO 24613-3 when implementing data categories referred to in the respective parts, and compliance with the W3C XML Schema 1.1 for representing structured information in XML. LBX extends the original models by means of data category selections and precise value lists, the creation of new subclasses and the definition of new constraints. In addition, this document complies with the cardinalities expressed in ISO 24613-1, ISO 24613-2, and ISO 24613-3. The LBX serialization is richer in detail than LMF, in order to meet specific design objectives. Still, this document does not elaborate on the metadata aspects from LMF, since the LBX schema is by essence much richer for the representation of all the aspects related to the creation, content, versioning and database implementation of lexical content at large. Occasionally, slightly equivalent constructs to explicit requirements from the LMF standard are mentioned.
译文:
本文件旨在为ISO 24613-1（核心模型）、ISO 24613-2（MRD扩展）和ISO 24613-3（词源扩展）中的每个LMF类提供相应结构。在实现各部分所涉及的数据类别时，应符合ISO 24613-1、ISO 24613-2和ISO 24613-3；在用XML表示结构化信息时，应符合W3C XML Schema 1.1。

LBX通过选择数据类别、规定明确的取值列表、创建新的子类和定义新的约束，扩展原有模型。此外，本文件遵守ISO 24613-1、ISO 24613-2和ISO 24613-3规定的基数约束。为满足特定设计目标，LBX序列化比LMF提供了更丰富的细节。

不过，本文件没有详述LMF的元数据方面。这是因为，在表示词汇内容的创建、内容本身、版本管理和数据库实现等各个方面时，LBX模式本身已经丰富得多。文中偶尔会提到与LMF标准明确要求略为等效的结构。

原文: 5.1 Implementing the LexicalResource class

原文: The LexicalResource class shall be implemented in LBX by means of the <LexicalResource> element (see Table 1), which groups together one to many lexicons in a single collection. This level may be omitted in cases where the lexical resource contains only one lexicon so that the resource starts directly with the lexicon level. In cases where a lexical resource contains a large number of lexicons or several very large lexicons, the lexicon (XML document) can reference a virtual lexical resource using a @lexicalResourceID in the <Lexicon> element and optionally the <LexicalEntry> element (see 5.5).

如果词汇资源包含大量词库或若干非常大的词库，词库（XML文档）可以在`<Lexicon>`元素中使用`@lexicalResourceID`来引用一个虚拟词汇资源，并可选择在`<LexicalEntry>`元素中也使用该属性（见5.5）。

原文: 5.2 Implementing the GlobalInformation class

原文: 5.3 Implementing the Lexicon class
译文: 5.3 实现`Lexicon`类

原文: The Lexicon class shall be implemented in LBX by means of the <Lexicon> element (see Table 3), which is a direct child of the <LexicalResource> element when <LexicalResource> is used. If the <LexicalResource> element is not used, <Lexicon> becomes the root element. In cases where a lexical resource contains a large number of lexicons or several very large lexicons, the lexicon (XML document) can reference a virtual lexical resource using a @lexicalResourceID in the <Lexicon> element (see 5.1). In the case of a virtual lexical resource, where the <LexicalResource> element is not part of the same XML document as the <Lexicon> element, the lexicon can use an include statement to reference a relevant <GlobalInformation> element. Other information within the <Lexicon> element should be qualified through the following child element(s) and attributes as direct children of the <Lexicon> element or, optimally, as children of the <LexiconInformation> element (see 5.4):
译文:
`Lexicon`类应在LBX中通过`<Lexicon>`元素实现（见表3）。使用`<LexicalResource>`时，`<Lexicon>`是它的直接子元素；不使用`<LexicalResource>`时，`<Lexicon>`成为根元素。

如果词汇资源包含大量词库或若干非常大的词库，词库（XML文档）可以通过`<Lexicon>`元素中的`@lexicalResourceID`引用一个虚拟词汇资源（见5.1）。在虚拟词汇资源的情况下，`<LexicalResource>`元素与`<Lexicon>`元素不在同一个XML文档中；此时词库可以使用包含语句来引用相关的`<GlobalInformation>`元素。

`<Lexicon>`元素中的其他信息，宜通过下列子元素和属性进一步说明。它们可以直接放在`<Lexicon>`元素之下；更合适的做法是放在`<LexiconInformation>`元素之下（见5.4）：

原文: — <Title>, the title of the lexicon;
译文: — `<Title>`：词库的标题；

原文: - @lexiconID, of datatype xs:ID as a unique identifier for the lexicon; as a best practice, the id should be a URI and be unique within a language resource; @xml:ID can be used in place of @lexiconID when there is a design intent to make the entry accessible on the web;
译文: — `@lexiconID`：数据类型为`xs:ID`，作为词库的唯一标识符。最佳实践是将该标识符设为URI，并使其在一个语言资源内唯一。如果设计目标是使词条能够通过网络访问，可以用`@xml:ID`替代`@lexiconID`；

原文: - @lexicalResourceID of datatype xs:ID as a unique identifier for the lexical resource; as a best practice, the ID should be a URI for global scope; in addition, @xml:ID can be used in place of @lexicalResourceID when there is a design intent to make the entry accessible on the web;
译文: — `@lexicalResourceID`：数据类型为`xs:ID`，作为词汇资源的唯一标识符。最佳实践是使用具有全局作用范围的URI。此外，如果设计目标是使词条能够通过网络访问，可以用`@xml:ID`替代`@lexicalResourceID`；

原文: - @lexiconType, of datatype "xs:string"; the type of lexicon, e.g. bilingual dictionary, monolingual dictionary;
译文: — `@lexiconType`：数据类型为`xs:string`，表示词库类型，例如双语辞典、单语辞典；

原文: - @sourceLanguage, of datatype "xs:string"; the language of the <Lemma> element or its inflected forms;
译文: — `@sourceLanguage`：数据类型为`xs:string`，表示`<Lemma>`元素或其屈折形式的语言；

原文: - @targetLanguage, of datatype "xs:string"; the language the lemma is translated to, principally represented in the <Translation> element.
译文: — `@targetLanguage`：数据类型为`xs:string`，表示词目形式所译入的语言，主要在`<Translation>`元素中体现。

原文: 6.1 Implementing OrthographicRepresentation subclasses

原文: The OrthographicRepresentation class in LBX shall be serialized by means of elements derived from the FormRepresentation and TextRepresentation classes or their subclasses described in ISO 24613-2. FormRepresentation subclasses are further described in 6.2 and TextRepresentation subclasses in 6.3.6. In all cases, these corresponding elements can be qualified by attributes, including @xml:lang, @script, and @notation. Other attributes, such as @representationType (e.g. canonicalForm, phoneticForm), are also available. An LBX implementation should use BCP 47 for language description, especially for the support of web-based applications, data interchange, and system interoperability (@script is not used when BCP 47 is implemented).
译文:
LBX中的`OrthographicRepresentation`类应通过源自ISO 24613-2所述`FormRepresentation`和`TextRepresentation`类或其子类的元素序列化。`FormRepresentation`子类的进一步说明见6.2，`TextRepresentation`子类见6.3.6。

在所有情况下，都可以用属性进一步说明相应元素，包括`@xml:lang`、`@script`和`@notation`。还可以使用其他属性，例如`@representationType`，其值可为`canonicalForm`、`phoneticForm`等。

LBX实现宜使用BCP 47描述语言，尤其是在支持网络应用、数据交换和系统互操作时；实现BCP 47时，不使用`@script`。

The goal of this design is to support effective resource management for large-scale, complex lexical databases (e.g. many lexicons encompassing many languages). When justified by design goals, simplification can be achieved by reducing the number of subclasses employed. 原文: 9 Additional mechanisms
译文: 9 附加机制

原文: 9.1 Overview
译文: 9.1 概述

原文: LBX provides additional features which do not correspond to classes or mechanisms introduced in the various models standardized in other parts of the ISO 24613 series. This clause introduces features that can be needed for a more precise representation of lexical content and meta-data in digitized dictionaries.
译文: LBX提供一些附加功能，它们不对应于ISO 24613系列其他部分所标准化的各模型中引入的类或机制。本章介绍这些功能；在数字化辞典中，要更精确地表示词汇内容和元数据时，可能需要它们。

原文: 9.2 XML feature structure implementation
译文: 9.2 XML特征结构的实现

原文: LBX provides a W3C feature structure implementation to support a more accurate representation of language specific linguistic features. Although ISO 24613-1:2019, 5.3.9, references the use of feature structures, there is no guidance on the specific mechanisms for implementation. This document describes a W3C XML schema implementation for feature structure representation (see Annex B for a more complete description). In addition, LBX provides a basic XML schema that does not include feature structures.
译文:
LBX提供一种基于W3C的特征结构实现，用来支持更准确地表示特定语言的语言学特征。虽然ISO 24613-1:2019的5.3.9提到了特征结构的使用，但未就具体的实现机制提供指导。

本文件描述一种用于表示特征结构的W3C XML模式实现，较完整的说明见附录B。此外，LBX还提供不包含特征结构的基础XML模式。

原文: In addition to the default LBX namespace (see Clause 4), LBX provides target namespaces to support language specific features, using unique namespace prefixes to define one or more target namespaces. 原文: The following example shows a simplified style that can be used for data exchange of a single lexicon (or other use cases), rather than an XML document supporting a large scale, multilingual database. For example, the <Pron> construct is inherited from the fully specified <FormRepresentation> where the @notation value is “French Pronunciation”. A description of applicable attribute-value pairs should be included in the <GlobalInformation> or <LexiconInformation>, as appropriate. For the purposes of data exchange, <GlobalInformation> or <LexiconInformation> can contain negotiated mappings of features and structures between the basic and complex styles.

下例展示一种简化写法，可用于单个词库的数据交换或其他使用情形，而不是用于支持大型多语言数据库的XML文档。例如，`<Pron>`结构继承自已作完整规定的`<FormRepresentation>`，后者的`@notation`值为“French Pronunciation”。

原文: C.2.3 Example of a Zulu noun entry

原文: The following example is a Zulu noun entry in a bilingual lexicon. This LBX style assumes that the example entry incorporates variant orthographic representations and may be intended for implementation in a proprietary large-scale language resource that includes lexicons from many different languages. The “Zulu Colenso” representation was used in the Zulu-English Dictionary $^{[5]}$ published by John Colenso in 1861. The <ZuluClassGroup> element derived from the <GrammaticalClassGroup> element describes a variant set of Zulu noun classes used for describing human roles.
译文:
下例是一个双语词库中的祖鲁语名词词条。这种LBX写法假定示例词条包含不同的正字法表示，而且可能用于一个专有的大型语言资源；该资源包含多种语言的词库。

原文: C.2.5 Example of a Zulu verb entry
译文: C.2.5 祖鲁语动词词条示例

原文: The following example describes an inchoative verb. In the present tense, an inchoative verb carries the meaning of starting or beginning an action. In the stative perfect tense, the verb has the meaning of state in the present tense. The LBX style here uses @xml:lang on the assumption that the goal is to publish the lexicon on the web. Another choice might be to remove the namespaces at the implementation stage. For example, <zulld:POS> becomes <POS>. The value /aCa/ indicates that the present tense form has the pattern /a/ /consonant/ /a/, producing the /e/ /consonant/ /e/ form in the stative perfective. The set of grammatical features at the LexicalEntry level, with the possible addition of other features, can be used to facilitate the building of a lexicon for a morphological analyzer.
译文:
下例描述一个起始动词。在现在时中，起始动词具有开始某一动作的意义；在状态完成时中，该动词具有表示当前状态的意义。这里的LBX写法假定目标是在网络上发布词库，因此采用`@xml:lang`。另一种选择是在实现阶段移除命名空间，例如将`<zulld:POS>`改为`<POS>`。

值`/aCa/`表示现在时形式具有`/a/ /辅音/ /a/`的模式，并在状态完成体中产生`/e/ /辅音/ /e/`形式。`LexicalEntry`层的这组语法特征可用于帮助建立供形态分析器使用的词库，并可按需补充其他特征。

原文: C.2.6 Example of a Russian verb entry
译文: C.2.6 俄语动词词条示例

原文: The following example from the Oxford Russian-English Dictionary $^{[6]}$ illustrates the use of LBX to mark up a fairly complex Russian verb entry, including different grammatical features for a <Lemma> and an inflected <WordForm>; variant <FormReps>, including a canonical Russian notation and a notation of stressed Russian in Cyrillic script; the use of the <Quote> element for managing variant notations used in the <Example>; and the use of the <Gloss> element for providing an English translation of the <Example>, differentiating the function of the <Gloss> from the function of the <Translation> element, which conveys the semantic meaning of the <Lemma>.
译文:
下面取自《牛津俄英辞典》[6]的示例，展示如何用LBX标记一个较复杂的俄语动词词条。内容包括：为`<Lemma>`和屈折变化后的`<WordForm>`记录不同语法特征；记录不同的`<FormReps>`，其中包括规范俄语记法及用西里尔文字标出重音的俄语记法；使用`<Quote>`元素管理`<Example>`中的不同记法。

该例还使用`<Gloss>`元素提供`<Example>`的英语翻译，从而区分`<Gloss>`与`<Translation>`的功能；后者传达`<Lemma>`的语义。

原文: NOTE Standardization of linguistic data categories that provide annotation content is provided by ISO 12620 and other related International Standards.
译文: 注：构成标注内容的语言数据类别的标准化，由ISO 12620及其他相关国际标准规定。

原文: f) Group: another group or set of groups. This can be used to group several enumeration groups whose IDs appear in different annotation documents.
译文: f) 组：另一个组或若干组的集合。可用于将其ID分布于不同标注文档的若干枚举组合并成一个组。

原文: Defines a unique name that may be associated with an annotation to enable the disambiguation of homonym identifiers residing in different namespaces, or to identify a logical grouping of annotations to be retained when merged with other annotations of the same data.
译文: 定义一个可与标注关联的唯一名称，用于区分不同命名空间中的同名标识符，或标识一组在与同一数据的其他标注合并时仍需保留的逻辑分组。

原文: Note to entry: Typically, primary data objects are addressed by "locations" in an electronic file, for example, the span of characters comprising a sentence or word, or a point at which a given temporal event begins or ends (as in speech annotation). More complex data objects may consist of a list or set of contiguous or non-contiguous locations in primary data.
译文: 注：源数据对象通常通过电子文件中的“位置”寻址，例如构成句子或词的字符区间，或某一时间事件开始或结束的时间点（如语音标注中的情形）。较复杂的数据对象可以由源数据中连续或非连续位置组成的列表或集合构成。

原文: In the case of reconstructed roots or other word forms, the attribute status serves to associate the element with a written description of the likelihood of its having been in use (see the example in A.8).
译文: 对于拟构词根或其他词形，status属性用于为该要素关联一段文字，说明它曾被使用的可能性（见A.8示例）。

原文: Note: The change realized in a process of dissimilation will likely involve another phonological process.
译文: 注：异化过程中发生的具体变化，很可能还涉及另一种音系过程。

原文: Note: It should be noted that while there is theoretical overlap between the ideas, the term “blending” with regards to this particular word formation process should not be attributed to the conceptual blending theory developed in References $[8]$ and $[9]$ .
译文: 注：应注意，尽管相关概念在理论上有所重叠，此处用于这一特定构词过程的“混成”一词不宜归于参考文献[8]和[9]所提出的概念整合理论。

原文: Possible values for type and subtype can vary according to the theoretical approach adopted by the compiler of a resource and/or the linguistic or editorial focus of the resource.
译文: type和subtype的可选值，可能随资源编纂者采用的理论方法和／或资源在语言学或编纂方面的侧重点而变化。

原文: Note: Metaphor in the context of etymology is differentiated from other spontaneous uses in language by the need for the term to be adopted (lexicalized) within the lexicon.
译文: 注：词源研究中的隐喻，要求相关用语被词汇系统接受，即发生词汇化；这一点使其区别于语言中其他自发的隐喻使用。

原文: Instances of either Etymon or Cognate can be assigned a language which is different from the language of the lexicon as a whole (this is specified in the LexiconInformation class as described in ISO 24613-1).
译文: 可为Etymon或Cognate的实例指定一种语言。这种语言可以与整部辞典的语言不同。辞典整体使用的语言由LexiconInformation类指定，见ISO 24613-1。

原文: meeting the conditions for having an etymology (3.3)
译文: 满足具有词源（3.3）的条件。

原文: Definition: A loanword in which only the meaning is borrowed with the term being literally translated into the borrowing language.
译文: 定义：一种只借入意义、通过将原词语直译成借入语而形成的借词。

原文: The example in Figure A.1 describes the inheritance of a lexical entry from a parent language, in this case the adverb semper in Sardinian which comes from the Latin word semper.
译文: 图A.1的示例描述了词条从祖语继承而来的情况：撒丁语副词semper来自拉丁语semper。

原文: Often these incorrect or popular re-interpretations (or re-analyses) are motivated by the phonotactic similarity of the item (or parts of it) to a more prominent or culturally familiar concept.
译文: 这些错误的或通俗的重新解释（或重新分析），往往源于该词（或其部分）与某个更显著或在文化上更熟悉的概念在音系配列方面的相似性。

原文: Definition: Inheritance, although often not regarded as an etymological process in itself, is used to identify situations where a lexical item is known to, or is presumed to, have been inherited from a predecessor or “parent” language(s).
译文: 定义：继承常常不被视为一种独立的词源过程，但可用来标示某一词汇单位已知或被推定继承自前身语言或“祖语”的情况。

原文: Definition: The process by which the sense of a word which formerly has a neutral or positive connotation changes to a negative or at least a reduced degree of positivity.
译文: 定义：一个词的词义由带有中性或正面色彩转为带有负面色彩，或至少正面色彩有所减弱的过程。

原文: Definition: The process by which the sense of a word which formerly has some negative connotation changes to a positive or at least a reduced degree of negativity.
译文: 定义：一个词的词义由带有某种负面色彩转为带有正面色彩，或至少负面色彩有所减弱的过程。

译文: 与 ISO 保持联络关系的国际组织，包括政府组织和非政府组织，也参与这项工作。

原文: EXAMPLE In the example given in 4.2.7, the link between the sense of the verb (i.e. "buy") and the predicate can be marked as Verb. The link between the sense of the noun (i.e. "buyer") and the predicate can be marked for instance as VerbNominalization. Clause A.2 provides an illustration of the way in which a verb and its nominalization can link to the same SemanticPredicate.
译文: 示例：在4.2.7的示例中，动词 buy 的意义与谓词之间的联系可标记为 Verb。名词 buyer 的意义与谓词之间的联系，例如可标记为 VerbNominalization。A.2说明了动词及其名词化形式如何链接到同一语义谓词。

原文: EXAMPLE In a LexicalEntry for the Italian verb "amare", a SyntacticBehaviour instance can be created and associated with a SubcategorizationFrame instance called regularSVOAvere. This latter instance describes the regular subject, verb, object structure with a verb using the auxiliary "avere".

原文: SubcategorizationFrameSet is a class representing a set of syntactic constructions and possibly the relationship between these constructions. A SubcategorizationFrameSet groups various syntactic constructions that appear frequently for certain sets of lexemes. The objective is to factorize syntactic descriptions and to maintain a minimum of SyntacticBehaviour instances in the lexicon.
译文: 次范畴化框架集（SubcategorizationFrameSet）类表示一组句法构式，也可表示这些构式之间的关系。它将某些词位集合中经常出现的多种句法构式组织在一起，以复用共有的句法描述，并尽量减少词库中的句法行为（SyntacticBehaviour）实例。

原文: Participation in a dialogue involves several activities beyond those strictly related to performing the task or activity for which the dialogue is instrumental. In natural conversation, the participants constantly evaluate the perception, understanding and reaction to each other’s intentions; the take turns, and the manage the use of time[4],[17]. Communication is thus a multi-faceted activity, and this is reflected in the multifunctionality that dialogue utterances often exhibit. Longer utterances are often sequentially multifunctional, i.e., it has parts which each have a different communicative function. A’s utterance in example (9) that spans the entire turn unit, for example, is a sequence of five functional segments, with communicative functions such as feedback giving, request, request, statement, and response elicitation.
译文: 参与对话不仅仅涉及完成该对话所服务的任务或活动，还涉及多个其他活动。在自然对话中，参与者不断评估对彼此意图的感知、理解和反应，轮流发言，并管理时间的使用[4]，[17]。因此，交际是一项多侧面的活动，这也反映在对话话语经常表现出的多功能性上。较长的话语通常是顺序多功能的，即话语包含几个部分，每个部分都有不同的交际功能。例如，在示例（9）中，A的话语跨越了整个话轮单元，是一个由五个功能段组成的序列，分别执行提供反馈、请求、请求、陈述和引发回应等交际功能。

原文: This annex describes the use of tripartite (or “triple-layered”) annotation plug-ins introduced in 9.3. Clause D.2 describes three alternative plug-ins for enriching dialogue act annotations with information about their semantic content. Clauses D.3 to D.5 describe other plug-ins that can be used to enrich dialogue act annotations or to make them more accurate, more specifically for adding the possibility of marking up rhetorical relations in dialogue by importing concepts from ISO 24617-8 (dealing with discourse relation annotation); for adding communicative functions for more fine-grained annotation of feedback and casual talk; for adding application-specific communicative functions; and for adding the possibility of marking up emotional aspects of the performance of a dialogue act.
译文: 本附录描述了9.3中引入的三部分构成的（或“三层”）标注插件的使用方式。D.2描述了三种替代插件，用语义内容的信息丰富对话行为的标注。D.3至D.5进一步介绍了其他可用于增强对话行为标注，或提升标注精确性的插件，具体包括：通过引入ISO 24617-8标准（涉及语篇关系标注）中的概念，实现对对话中修辞关系的标记功能。为反馈和闲聊的细粒度标注添加交际功能，添加应用特定的交际功能，以及增加标记对话行为执行过程中情感表现的可能性。

译文: 注3：术语“话轮单元”虽有助于描述对话（3.5）的各种行为，但在本文件中并不非常重要，因为并未假定对话行为（3.6）与话轮单元相对应。

原文: An annotation structure is a set of entity structures and link structures. Entity structures contain semantic information about a dialogue segment; link structures describe semantic relations between entity structures. Entity structures are always of the general form 〈m,z〉, where ‘m’ is a markable and ‘z’ designates a structure that describes some linguistic information. Link structures are typically of the form 〈e1, e2, R〉, consisting of two entity structures and a relation.
译文: 标注结构是一组实体结构和链接结构。实体结构包含关于对话段的语义信息。链接结构描述实体结构之间的语义关系。实体结构总是以<m,z>形式表示，其中m是标注对象，z表示描述某些语言信息的结构。链接结构通常采用<e1,e2,R>的形式，由两个实体结构和一个关系组成。

原文: Discourse Structuring acts are concerned with the explicit structuring of the dialogue. Such acts occur frequently at the beginning and near the end of a dialogue. A dialogue needs to be opened in some way, and there are conventional ways of doing so. In multi-party dialogue an expression that is frequently used to open the dialogue is “Okay”. The same utterance is often used (though with a different intonation and slow tempo) to indicate that a dialogue can be closed, indicating positive feedback concerning the entire preceding dialogue. There do not seem to exist dialogue acts that have the sole function of closing a dialogue; conventionally, a dialogue is considered closed when the participants have exchanged farewell greetings.
译文: 话语结构行为用于显式组织对话。这种行为经常发生在对话开始和接近结束时。对话需要以某种方式开启，且存在约定俗成的开启方式。在多方对话中，经常用来打开对话的表达是“好的”。同一话语（尽管以不同的语调和缓慢节奏）也常被用于表示对话可以结束，表示对整个先前对话的积极反馈。似乎不存在仅以结束对话为唯一功能的话语行为。按照惯例，当参与者互致告别问候时，对话即被视为结束。

原文: The pre-final utterance “Public Transportation Information wishes you a pleasant journey“ in functional segment fs23.1 has been interpreted as a signal that the system is moving to the end of the dialogue, and therefore annotated as an interaction structuring act. A more accurate annotation would result from using the plug-in with additional communicative functions in the SOM dimension, defined in Clause D.4, and assigning the communicative function Farewell Wish to this utterance.
译文: 功能段fs23.1中的倒数第二句话“公共交通信息祝您旅途愉快”被理解为系统准备结束对话的信号，因此被标注为交互结构化行为。若采用D.4中定义的、在社交义务管理维度增加交际功能的插件，并将该话语标注为“告别祝愿”（Farewell Wish），可以得到更准确的标注。

原文: In linguistics, coercion occurs when the grammatical context causes the language-user to reinterpret all or parts of the semantic and/or formal features of a lexeme that appear in that context.

译文: 施事可以是有生命的，也可以只是看起来有生命，或被认为是有生命的；

原文: Being obligatory also seems to be linked to a second property of arguments, which is that the types of arguments associated with a predicate can be specific to that predicate since they are based on its semantics.

原文:
This document provides a set of empirically and theoretically well-motivated concepts for dialogue 
annotation, a formal language for expressing dialogue annotations (the Dialogue Act Markup Language, 
DiAML), and a method for segmenting a dialogue into semantic units. This allows the manual or 
automatic annotation of dialogue segments with information about the communicative actions which 
the participants perform by their contributions to the dialogue. The annotation scheme specified in 
this document supports multidimensional annotation of spoken, written, and multimodal dialogues 
involving two or more participants. Dialogue units are viewed as having multiple communicative 
functions in different dimensions. The markup language DiAML has an XML-based representation format 
and a formal semantics which makes it possible to perform inferences with DiAML representations. 
This document also specifies data categories for dimensions of dialogue analysis, for communicative 
functions, for dialogue act qualifiers, and for relations between dialogue acts. Additionally, it provides 
mechanisms for customizing these sets of concepts, extending them with application-specific or 
domain-specific concepts and descriptions of semantic content, or selecting relevant coherent subsets 
of them. These mechanisms make the dialogue act concepts specified in this document useful not only 
for annotation but also for the recognition and generation of dialogue acts in interactive systems.
译文: 本文件给出一套具有充分实证和理论依据的对话标注概念、一种表达对话标注的形式语言——对话行为标记语言（DiAML），以及一种将对话划分为语义单元的方法。借助这些概念、语言和方法，可手动或自动地为对话片段添加标注，记录参与者通过对话贡献所实施的交际行动。本文件规定的标注方案支持对涉及两个或多个参与者的口语、书面语和多模态对话进行多维标注。对话单元被视为在不同维度上具有多种交际功能。DiAML具有基于XML的表示格式和形式语义，因而可利用其表示进行推理。本文件还规定了对话分析维度、交际功能、对话行为限定语以及对话行为间关系的数据类别，并提供了定制这些概念集的机制：可加入特定应用或领域的概念以及语义内容描述，也可选取相关且连贯的子集。这些机制使本文件规定的对话行为概念不仅可用于标注，也可用于交互系统中对话行为的识别与生成。

原文: Where in (7a) having the flu is the cause of not coming in (‘semantic cause’), in (8) beating his children is not the cause of Jim being an idiot, but is a reason for the speaker to say that Jim is an idiot, so the causal relation is between the semantic content of the second dialogue act and the performance of the first (‘pragmatic cause’).

原文: The term ‘Own Communication Management' has been introduced[6],[7] for describing the communicative activity of a speaker relating to the management, planning, and execution of his/her own speech production. This activity is indispensable in the description of spoken dialogue, and is illustrated by the occurrence of speech-editing acts such as (self-)repairs and restarts.
译文: 引入了“自我交际管理”一词[6],[7]，用于描述讲话者在自身言语生成过程中所进行的管理、规划和执行有关的交际活动。这种活动在口语对话的描述中不可或缺，其典型表现为言语编辑行为，例如（自我）修正与重新起说。

原文: The prototypical case of a directive function is the Instruct, where the speaker puts pressure on the addressee to perform a certain action. The Request is a conditional directive, which puts pressure on an addressee to perform the requested action if he/she agrees to do so. Note that accepting a request or a suggestion is itself a commissive act, and accepting an offer is a directive act.
译文: 指令类功能的典型例子是指示（Instruct），讲话者向接收者施加压力，促使其执行某项行为。请求（Request）是一种有条件的指令，在接收者同意的情况下促使其执行所请求的行为。应注意，接受请求或建议本身是一种承诺类行为，而接受提议是一种指令类行为。

原文: The mother-daughter relation in this taxonomy reflects increasing specialization going from mother to daughter; sisters in the taxonomy are mutually exclusive alternatives. The fact that the set of general- purpose functions forms a tree structure shows their semantic connectedness, and can be exploited in annotation processes by using the structure as a decision tree; see Annex E. The general-purpose functions can be used to build a dialogue act in any dimension by combining the function with a semantic content of the category of that dimension. The definitions of the core general-purpose functions are provided in Annex C in the form of data categories conforming to ISO 12620.
译文: 这种分类中所体现的“母类—子类”关系反映出语义功能从母类向子类逐步特化的趋势；而同属一母类的“姊妹类”功能则构成互斥的备选项。通用功能构成树状结构，这一结构形式体现了其语义上的关联性。在语义标注过程中，该结构可被用作决策树以辅助标注判断，详见附录E。通用功能可与不同维度类别中的语义内容结合，用于构建任一维度上的对话行为。附录C以符合ISO 12620的数据类别的形式提供了核心通用功能的定义。

原文: Definition Communicative function of a dialogue act performed by the sender, S, in order to know which one from a list of alternative propositions, specified by the semantic content, is true; S believes that exactly one element of that list is true; S assumes that the ad­ dressee, A, knows which of the alternative propositions is true, and S puts pressure on A to provide this information.
译文: 定义 | 发送者S执行的对话行为的交际功能，以便知道语义内容指定的备选命题列表中的哪一个为真。S相信该列表中恰好有一个命题为真。S假设接收者A知道哪个备选命题为真，S向A施加压力，要求其提供该信息。

原文: A's utterance may be understood as an Offer; due to the fact that expressions of the form “Would you like…” are commonly used for that purpose; B's response is an Accept Offer by virtue of its linguistic form and the fact that it occurs immediately after an Offer. Since an offer can only be accepted when it has been understood, B's response by implication also has a positive auto-feedback function.
译文: A的话语可被理解为提议（Offer）行为，“你想……吗”这一语言形式通常用以表达该类意图。B 的回应可视为对该提议的“接受”（Accept Offer），其依据在于该回应的语言形式及其紧随提议行为之后的语境。由于只有在对提议行为进行理解的前提下才能作出接受反应，因此可以推知 B 的回应还隐含具有“积极自体反馈”（positive auto-feedback）的交际功能。

原文: Effective creation, encoding, processing and management of language resources is facilitated by a single high-level data model that supports analysis and design of both annotation schemes and representation formats. This International Standard is designed to support the development and use of computer applications relying on linguistically annotated resources and the exchange of these resources among different applications.
译文: 统一的高层数据模型能够支持标注方案和表示格式的分析与设计，有助于有效创建、编码、处理和管理语言资源。本国际标准旨在支持依赖带有语言标注的资源的计算机应用的开发与使用，以及这些资源在不同应用之间的交换。

原文: — Any number of annotation documents containing nodes, edges and feature structures associated with some or all of the nodes and/or edges in a directed graph. All nodes reference either a base segmentation document (in which case the node has no outgoing edges) or other nodes in the same or other annotation documents via edges. (See 3.3.3).
译文: ——任意数量的标注文档，内含有向图的节点和边，以及与其中部分或全部节点和／或边关联的特征结构。所有节点要么引用基础切分文档（此时没有出边），要么通过边引用同一文档或其他标注文档中的节点（见3.3.3）。

原文: In the general case, primary data does not contain markup of any kind. If markup does exist in primary data (e.g. HTML or XML tags), it is treated as a part of the data stream by referring annotations; no distinction is made between markup and other characters in the data when referring to locations in the document.
译文: 通常，源数据不包含任何置标。如果存在置标（例如HTML或XML标记），引用源数据的标注也将其视为数据流的一部分；在引用文档中的位置时，不区分置标字符与其他字符。

译文: 引用非连续区域时，可先为各组成区域建立引用它们的节点，再增加一个与这些节点相链接的节点。

原文: SyntacticBehaviour is a class representing one of the possible syntactic behaviours of a lexeme. It is a subclass of CrossREF, linking a LexicalEntry instance with a SubcategorizationFrame instance. The presence in a given lexicon of one SyntacticBehaviour instance for a lexical entry means that this entry can have this behaviour in the language under description. Syntactic description is optional, so it is possible to describe morphology and semantics without any syntactic description. LexicalEntry, SyntacticBehaviour and Sense instances form a triangle representing morphology, syntax and semantics. A detailed description of the syntactic behaviour of a lexical entry is defined by the SubcategorizationFrame instance.
译文: 句法行为（SyntacticBehaviour）类表示词位的一种可能句法行为，是交叉引用（CrossREF）的子类，用于连接词条（LexicalEntry）实例与次范畴化框架（SubcategorizationFrame）实例。词库中某词条具有句法行为实例，表示它在所描述的语言中可以呈现这种句法行为。句法描述是可选的，因此可只描述形态和语义而不作句法描述。词条、句法行为和义项（Sense）的实例构成分别对应形态、句法和语义的三角关系。词条句法行为的详细描述由次范畴化框架实例给出。

本文件旨在描述笔译、口译及相关技术国际标准中使用的概念。在这些领域，从业人员对某些概念使用不同的名称。预计这些差异不会在短期内消失；但从长远看，相关国际标准在术语和定义方面的一致性可能对实践产生规范作用。
本文件术语条目中的信息按照 ISO 10241-1 组织，概念尽可能按照 ISO 1087:2019 中3.7.11定义的主题顺序分组。相关概念分别归入以下小标题：关键概念；笔译与口译的通用概念；与笔译相关的概念；与口译相关的概念；与技术相关的概念。最后一组又分为与笔译技术相关的概念和与口译技术相关的概念。
本文件力求先界定相关概念，再使用相应术语，以免读者在另一个概念的定义中首次遇到某术语时，尚不清楚其含义。例如，先界定“会场原声”，再在“语言分发”的定义中使用该术语。
为方便读者，文末提供索引，按字母顺序列出所有英文术语及其对应的术语条目编号。

Fluent speech is relatively rare in spontaneous conversation. Disfluent speech production commonly

from retrieving a word to deciding what to talk about next, speakers may experience difficulties which
give rise to delays [30]. These delays can be minor, giving rise to stalling acts, or prolonged, when the

原文: An annotation structure is a set of entity structures and link structures. Entity structures contain semantic information about a dialogue segment; link structures describe semantic relations between entity structures. Entity structures are always of the general form 〈m,z〉, where ‘m’ is a markable and ‘z’ designates a structure that describes some linguistic information. Link structures are typically of the form 〈e1, e2, R〉, consisting of two entity structures and a relation.

原文: A dialogue act tag set can be structured according to multiple dimensions by basing the notion of ‘dimension’ on the observation that dialogue participants share information not only about the task they pursue but also about the processing of each other’s messages, about the allocation of turns, about contact and attention, about the use of time, and about various other aspects of the interaction. They thus perform communicative activities of various types, such as giving and eliciting feedback, taking turns, stalling for time, establishing contact, and showing attention, in addition to those for advancing a certain task or performing a certain activity[14]. Each of these types of activity is concerned with a different category of information. In this document the term ‘dimension’ is used to refer to these categories and the corresponding activities. This leads to dimensions such as auto-feedback, turn management, time management, and contact management, besides the dimension formed by the task that motivates the dialogue. Subclause 7.2 describes the dimensions defined in this document.
译文: 对话行为标签集可以按多个维度组织。维度这一概念基于以下观察：对话参与者不仅交流所要完成的任务的信息，还交流对彼此话语的处理、话轮分配、接触与注意、时间使用及交互其他方面的信息。因此，除了推进任务或开展活动，他们还会提供和引出反馈、获取话轮、争取时间、建立接触并表示注意[14]。每类活动涉及不同类别的信息。本文件将这些信息类别及相应活动称为“维度”。由此，除促成对话的任务所形成的维度外，还可区分自体反馈、话轮管理、时间管理和接触管理等维度。7.2介绍本文件定义的维度。

原文: Example: English cherry, a loanword from Old French cheris (Modern French cerise) was assumed to be plural because of the -s, thus the singular form in English was adapted to cherry and the plural cherries. 译文: 英语 cherry 是借自古法语 cheris（现代法语 cerise）的外来词。由于词尾 -s 被误认为复数标记，英语单数形式被调整为 cherry，复数形式为 cherries。第二类逆构的例子是由名词 conversation 形成动词 conversate。

原文: A particular sentiment associated with a dialogue act may be annotated if the sender indicates a positive or negative feeling or attitude concerning the semantic content. A sentiment can be expressed verbally by the choice of adjectives or adverbs, such as “(un)fortunately” and “regrettably”. Nonverbal expressions of sentiment exist in abundance and in great variety, for instance smiling (positive), pressing lips together (negative), and sighing (negative).
译文: 当发送者对语义内容表达积极或消极的感受或态度时，可标注与该对话行为相关的特定情感。情感可通过形容词或副词表达，如“幸运的是”“不幸的是”和“遗憾地”。非言语情感表达也十分丰富多样，如微笑（积极）、抿嘴（消极）和叹气（消极）。

原文: The multifunctionality of dialogue behaviour is optimally accounted for when communicative functions are assigned to all those segments of behaviour that expresses a dialogue act. Such segments are called functional segments, defined more precisely as a minimal stretch of communicative behaviour that has a communicative function (possibly more than one, see also definition 3.11). The condition of being ‘minimal' ensures that functional segments do not include material that does not contribute to the expression of its communicative function(s). A consequence of this definition is that functional segments may be discontinuous, may overlap, may be embedded in another functional segment, may spread over multiple turns, and may contain parts contributed by different speakers.
译文: 当为每个表达对话行为的行为片段都分配交际功能时， 对话行为的多功能性可以得到最充分的体现。这些片段被称为功能段，更准确的定义是：具有一个或多个交际功能的最小交际行为片段（另见定义3.11）。“最小”的条件确保了功能段不包括与其交际功能无关的内容。这个定义的结果是，功能段可能是不连续的、重叠的，嵌入到另一个功能段中，可能分散在多个话轮中，甚至可能包含来自不同讲话者的内容。

原文: This document will help further improve the clarity of business reporting overall by establishing consistent design requirements (a standardized notation) for data visuals, such as charts and tables, and for text objects that add associated meaning.
译文: 本文件为图表、表格等数据视觉对象及提供相应说明的文本对象确立统一的设计要求，即标准化的表示法，从而有助于进一步提高业务报告整体的清晰度。

原文: Consistent notation assists the audience to recognize patterns and grasp the meaning quickly, clearly and accurately. Also organizations will save time and money as it will be quicker for authors to use an existing standard rather than having to develop custom notations and then negotiate them with internal stakeholders.
译文: 统一的表示法有助于受众识别模式，并快速、清楚、准确地理解信息。组织也能节省时间和资金，因为对编写者而言，采用现成标准，比自行设计表示法并与内部相关方协商更快捷。

译文: 通过为一组语料库（3.1.5）添加元数据或标签，补充语言、非语言、语义或结构信息，以促进分析、研究和自然语言处理工具开发的项目（3.2.9）。

原文: SemanticPredicate is a class representing an abstract meaning together with its association with the SemanticArgument class. A SemanticPredicate instance may be used to represent the common meaning between different senses that are not necessarily fully synonymous. These senses may be linked to LexicalEntry instances whose parts of speech are different. A SemanticPredicate instance pertains to a given Lexicon instance.
译文: 语义谓词（SemanticPredicate）类表示抽象意义以及它与语义论元（SemanticArgument）类的关联。其实例可表示不同义项共有的意义，而这些义项未必完全同义，也可属于词性不同的词条。每个语义谓词实例归属于特定的词库（Lexicon）实例。

原文: NL is used for communication between humans in general and contains ambiguous expressions. By contrast, CNL is a disambiguated language that either contains non-ambiguous expressions as primary text of CNL or needs additional disambiguating information for any ambiguous expressions in CNL text.
译文: 自然语言通常用于人际交流，并含有歧义表达。相比之下，CNL 是经过消歧的语言：其主体文本采用无歧义的表达，或者需要为文本中的歧义表达补充消歧信息。

原文: CNL is different from natural language and from artificial languages such as formal logics and programming languages. A CNL (e.g. controlled English) is a subset of the NL (in this case, English) that forms its base because every well-formed expression (word, phrase, or sentence) in the former is a well-formed expression in the latter. All CNLs have some traits of artificial language because they are intentionally and systematically modified or constrained by humans and the outcome involves rules and restricted vocabulary.
译文: CNL 不同于自然语言，也不同于形式逻辑、编程语言等人工语言。CNL（如受控英语）是其基础自然语言（本例中为英语）的子集，因为 CNL 中每个良构表达（词、短语或句子）也都是该自然语言中的良构表达。所有 CNL 都带有某些人工语言特征，因为它们经过人为的、有意识且系统性的修改或约束，从而形成相应规则和受限词汇。

原文: Tone is a set of styles that creates a specific atmosphere in a document. Many styles can affect the tone in English. If a variety of writing styles (e.g. a mixture of all of the styles given in Table 2) appear in a single document, it becomes complicated and disorganized, making it hard to read. If a manufacturer publishes such a document, it is possible that the manufacturer will be considered to be a mediocre company and the credibility of its products can be affected.
译文: 语气由一组风格特征共同构成，在文档中营造特定氛围。英语中的许多风格特征都会影响语气。如果同一文档混用多种写作风格（例如混用表2所列的不同特征），文档就会显得复杂、缺乏条理，难以阅读。制造商发布这样的文档，可能使人认为该公司水平一般，并影响人们对其产品的信任。
