原文: Disjunctive values are allowed by FSR and can also be simplified, following the same mechanism (see Figure 32, which shows fragmentary feature-value and feature specification libraries containing a definition of a value that is neutral between the first and the third person, making it possible to handle the morphological ambiguity in the example of the inflected French verb porte, interpretable as either the first or the third person form of porter “visit”).
译文: FSR 允许使用析取值，也可按同一机制简化其表示。图32给出特征值库和特征规约库的片段，其中定义了一个保留第一人称和第三人称两种可能的值。该值可用于处理法语动词 porter（“访问”）的屈折形式 porte 所具有的人称歧义：porte 既可解释为第一人称形式，也可解释为第三人称形式。

原文: The LexiconInformation class shall be implemented in LBX by means of the <LexiconInformation> element (see Table 4) either by referencing a LexiconInformation.xsd schema using an <xsd:include> element or as a direct child of the <Entry> element.
译文: `LexiconInformation`类应在LBX中通过`<LexiconInformation>`元素实现（见表4）。可以使用`<xsd:include>`元素引用`LexiconInformation.xsd`模式，也可以把`<LexiconInformation>`元素作为`<Entry>`元素的直接子元素。

原文: The <Cognate> element can contain a further element which contains the description of the current etymon.
译文: `<Cognate>`元素可以包含另一个元素，其中存放对当前源词的描述。

原文: Move the description just after the sentence or paraphrase the sentence.
译文: 将该说明紧接在该句之后另行写出，或改写该句。

原文: Style is mainly used to create the cosmetic appearance of sentences.
译文: 行文风格主要用于塑造句子的外在表现形式。

原文: — the @lemmaRef attribute can be used to point to a lexical entry (or a subpart of an entry);
译文: @lemmaRef 属性可用于指向词条（或词条的子部分）；

原文: For example, the <Pron> construct is inherited from the fully specified <FormRepresentation> where the @notation value is “French Pronunciation”.
译文: 例如，`<Pron>`结构继承自已作完整规定的`<FormRepresentation>`，后者的`@notation`值为“French Pronunciation”。

原文: Regarding the modelling of syntax in Figure 1, a LexicalEntry may have one or more instances of SyntacticBehaviour, associated with separate SubcategorizationFrame instances, each described with SyntacticArgument.
译文: 就图1的句法建模而言，一个词条可具有一个或多个句法行为实例；这些句法行为实例与各自的次范畴化框架实例相关联，各次范畴化框架实例均用句法论元描述。

原文: A SynSemCorrespondence would then contain three SynSemArgMap instances: one to map the Donor with the Subject, one to map the Recipient with Object1, and one to map Theme with Object2.
译文: 此时，一个句法-语义对应就包含三个句法-语义论元映射实例：一个将给予者映射到主语，一个将接受者映射到宾语1，一个将客体映射到宾语2。

原文: Note 1 to entry: This includes version control of revised documents, contents in versions of similar documents, and the management of relations between items in a document.
译文: 注：包括对修订后文档的版本控制、类似文档各版本中的内容管理，以及文档中各内容项之间关系的管理。

原文: The writing rules are not based solely on one language, as is the traditional practice, but instead by comparing English with a linguistically different language such as Japanese.
译文: 与传统做法不同，这些写作规则并非只以一种语言为基础，而是通过比较英语与日语等在语言特点上不同于英语的语言而形成。

原文: Yes: The comparatively large sounds of the stream in the straits located in the designated area are steady and comfortable.
译文: 正确：指定区域海峡中的水流声相对较大，平稳而令人感到舒适。

原文: Terms that will be transparent to a given target audience.
译文: 特定目标受众能够清楚理解的术语。

原文: Predicate which can be associated with a communicative function to express that the sender of a dialogue act with that function is certain about the correctness of the information that he/she provides.
译文: 可与交际功能相联的谓词，表示具有该功能的对话行为的发送者确信自己提供的信息是正确的。

原文: The PID framework should provide a proxy resolver implementation that is able to resolve urlified PIDs. This allows web clients to resolve such an identifier using the HTTP scheme without needing special browser plug- ins or other special software.
译文: PID框架宜提供能够解析URL化PID的代理解析器实现。Web客户端可据此采用HTTP方案解析这类标识符，无需特殊浏览器插件或其他专用软件。

原文: procedures prior, or related, to the handing over of a physical product (3.1.3) ready to be placed into service
译文: 在准备好投入使用的实物产品（3.1.3）移交之前进行的程序，或与该移交有关的程序。

原文: information for use (3.1.2) which comprises additional details that need to be retrieved on occasion
译文: 由需要时检索的补充性详细信息构成的使用信息（3.1.2）。

原文: principle of information quality (3.6.5.1) according to which information for use (3.1.2) includes all relevant information with the least amount of other information needed to be complete
译文: 使用信息（3.1.2）包含全部相关信息，并将为保证完整性所需的其他信息控制在最少量的信息质量（3.6.5.1）原则。

原文: A process has its input to activate the process and the list of outputs.
译文: 每个过程均有启动该过程所需的输入，以及该过程的产出清单。

原文: Transduction practices applied to transform the data from its source format (e.g. PDF, recorded speech). Correction practices applied to the data in its source form, such as spelling correction or normalization of special characters.
译文: <transduction>：将数据从源格式（例如PDF或语音录音格式）转换时所采用的方法。 <correction>：针对源形式数据采用的更正方法，例如拼写更正或特殊字符规范化。

原文: use a document or data for purposes in addition to those for which it was originally designed
译文: 将文档或数据用于其原设计用途以外的其他用途。

原文: CNL can reduce costs because it produces more controlled text and this makes it easier for humans and computer systems to translate it.
译文: CNL 能生成控制程度更高的文本，使人和计算机系统都更容易翻译这类文本，从而降低成本。

原文: Yes: If the shims are installed, remove them.
译文: 正确：如果已经安装了垫片，请将其拆下。

原文: The goal of this design is to support effective resource management for large-scale, complex lexical databases (e.g. many lexicons encompassing many languages).
译文: 这种设计旨在支持对大型复杂词汇数据库进行高效的资源管理，例如包含多种语言、多部词典的数据库。

原文: The TextRepresentation class can be implemented in LBX as an optional construct to contain the text literal of a Definition.
译文: 对于 Definition 的文本内容，也可以选择使用 TextRepresentation 类所对应的构造来承载。

原文: It contains examples of usage illustrating a particular sense of the Form.
译文: <Example> 元素包含用法示例，用于说明某一 Form 的特定义项。

原文: which do not correspond to classes or mechanisms introduced in the various models standardized in other parts of the ISO 24613 series.
译文: 这些特性不对应于 ISO 24613 系列其他部分所规定模型中的类或机制。

原文: In the following example, the complex type includes a reference to the GramFeats choice group that is applicable for all declared languages.
译文: 以下示例中的复杂类型引用了一个 GramFeats 选择组，该选择组适用于所有已声明的语言。

原文: Such models are defined independently of any specific formats and ensure that an implementer has the necessary conceptual instrument with which to design and compare formats with regard to their degrees of interoperability.
译文: 这些模型在定义时不依赖任何特定格式，并能确保实施者具备必要的概念工具，使其能够从互操作程度这一角度设计和比较各种格式。

原文: In order to be shared across various annotation schemas and encoding applications, such semantics should be implemented as a centralized repository of concepts:
译文: 为使这些语义能够在不同标注模式和编码应用之间共享，宜通过集中式概念库加以表示。

原文: Such properties can range from the simple identification of a lemma up to an explicit reference to a lexical entry in a dictionary.
译文: 这些属性的描述范围，可以从简单标明词目，延伸到明确引用词典中的某个词条。

原文: Inline token annotation strategies for token separation
译文: 用于分隔词元的内嵌式标注策略

原文: It can also be characterized by part-of-speech information that expresses morphological and grammatical properties as a feature structure (see 7.2).
译文: 还可以用词性信息刻画词形；这些信息以特征结构的形式表达形态属性和语法属性（见7.2）。

原文: it is sometimes useful not to rely on such an implicit relationship but rather use an explicit identifier for that data category, to distinguish it from other morphosyntactic data categories, such as gender, tense, etc.
译文: 不过，有时为该类别提供显式标识符，比依赖这种隐含关系更有用。显式标识符有助于将“词性”与性、时态等其他形态句法数据类别区分开来。

原文: As linguistic abstractions, word-forms can be qualified by various linguistic features characterizing the morphosyntactic properties that are instantiated in the realization of the lexical entry within the annotated text.
译文: 词形作为语言抽象，可以用各种语言特征加以刻画。这些特征描述词条在已标注文本中实际出现时所体现的形态句法属性。

原文: Implementers are encouraged to use external reference taxonomies as described by ISO 12620-2 either directly, or by building on them in defining their own categories (appropriate in the coverage, scope or semantics to the requirements of the given encoding project), in conformity with ISO/TC 37 principles.
译文: 鼓励实施者遵循 ISO/TC 37 的原则，直接采用 ISO 12620-2 所述的外部参照分类体系，或在这些分类体系的基础上定义自己的类别，使这些类别在覆盖范围、适用范围或语义方面满足具体编码项目的要求。

原文: The following documents are referred to in the text in such a way that some or all of their content constitutes requirements of this document.
译文: 下列文件在正文中被引用，其部分或全部内容构成本文件的要求。

原文: Note 2 to entry: The term “lemma” is most often used in the context of corpora, as a device to capture the identity of tokens $(3.21)$ and establish basic correspondence between a token and a lexical entry $(3.9)$ . The term that corresponds to lemma in the context of lexicons $(3.10)$ is “headword”. Mismatches between the two are possible due to the varying macro- and microstructure of lexical entries. In order to handle such mismatches, apart from lemmas, direct references to dictionary entries are sometimes added to tokens or word-forms $(3.5)$ in corpora.
译文: “词目”这一术语主要用于语料库语境。词目用于确认词元（3.21）的身份，并建立词元与词条（3.9）之间的基本对应关系。在词库（3.10）语境中，与词目对应的术语是“词头”。由于词条的宏观结构和微观结构不尽相同，词目与词头可能无法对应。为处理这种不匹配，语料库有时在提供词目的同时，还为词元或词形（3.5）添加指向词典条目的直接引用。

原文: Sometimes a modification of a lexeme is not overtly marked, and sometimes the morpheme is a combined (fused) exponent of various kinds of morphosyntactic information.
译文: 有时，词位的变化没有显性标记；有时，一个语素则融合体现了多种形态句法信息。

原文: ISO 24612 makes use of anchors that utilize inter-character points in order to refer to locations in between the base units of the data representation.
译文: ISO 24612 以字符之间的位置设置锚点，用于指示数据表示中基本单元之间的位置。

原文: The choice between them comes into play where a single element (or a tight element complex, such as the f/symbol complex illustrated above) make it necessary or useful to distinguish between the container data category and its value.
译文: 在单个元素或紧密组合的多个元素（例如上文的 f/symbol 组合）中，如果需要区分容器数据类别与其值，或作出这种区分有益，就涉及 datcat 与 valueDatcat 的选用。

原文: Individuals of the class can either represent paraphrases or synonyms and these may be in the language of the entry or in another language.
译文: 该类实例可包含解释性释文或同义词，所用语言可为条目语言或其他语言。

原文: origin and historical development of any aspect of a given lexical item
译文: 某一词汇项在任何方面的起源及历史演变。

原文: The use of CognateSet implies that the LexicalEntry (and therefore Etymon and Cognate) instances which it contains share an etymological source.
译文: 使用 CognateSet，意味着其中包含的 LexicalEntry 实例（包括其 Etymon 和 Cognate 子类实例）具有共同的词源来源。

原文: The components of the compound are represented as Etymons containing the salient forms as Lemma.
译文: 复合词的各个组成部分用 Etymon 表示，并在每个 Etymon 中以 Lemma 记录相应的主要词形。

原文: Central to grammaticalization is a continuum of bondedness
译文: 语法化的一个核心特征，是形式之间结合紧密程度构成的连续统。

原文: There are numerous potential subvarieties of assimilation along several different dichotomies and traits, which can intersect, these are: total-partial, contact-distant, and regressive-progressive.
译文: 同化可沿不同的对立维度或特征划分出许多下位类型，并且这些分类维度可以相互交叉，例如完全同化与部分同化、接触同化与远距同化、逆向同化与顺向同化。

原文: but whereas clipping generally refers to the removal of an extended portion of a lexical item, deletion is generally used in reference to the deletion of a single phonetic segment.
译文: 截短通常指删去词汇项中较长的一段形式，而这里的 deletion 通常指单个语音片段的脱落。

原文: Japanese regularly uses epenthesis when introducing a loanword in order to make it conform to that language's phonotactic system
译文: 日语在借入外来词时经常插入语音，以使借词符合日语的语音配列规则。

原文: The historical phonological process by which phone becomes less constricted.
译文: 弱化指某个音在历时变化中发音气流受阻程度减小的过程。

原文: The @corresp attribute ensures explicit correspondence between the <listAnnotation> element and the sentence whose contents are being annotated, and the @target attribute encodes the relationship between the <span> elements and the tokens that represent the given word-form.
译文: @corresp 属性明确建立 <listAnnotation> 元素与所标注句子之间的对应关系；@target 属性则编码 <span> 元素与表示相应词形的词元之间的关系。

原文: This indirect way is a convenience mapping of relationships defined by ISO 24610-1. For example, fragment @pos="N" is a convenience shorthand that expresses information defined by <f name="pos"><symbol value="noun"/></f>, which is part of a library of morphosyntactic feature structures.
译文: 这种间接方式以便于使用的形式映射 ISO 24610-1 所定义的关系。例如，@pos="N" 是一种简写，用于表达 <f name="pos"><symbol value="noun"/></f> 所定义的信息；这个编码片段属于形态句法特征结构库。

原文: Faceted classification systems allow the assignment of multiple classifications to an object. An object may be characterized by any combination of the classes from the facets.
译文: 分面式分类系统允许从多个分面对一个客体进行分类。客体可以通过各分面中类别的任意组合加以表征。

原文: model of a fictitious user (3.2.1) with defined properties, based on information research (3.6.1.2)
译文: 基于信息调研（3.6.1.2）、具有明确特征的虚构用户（3.2.1）模型。

原文: The example in Figure A.1 describes the inheritance of a lexical entry from a parent language, in this case the adverb semper in Sardinian which comes from the Latin word semper.
译文: 图 A.1 的示例描述了词条从祖源语言继承而来的情形：撒丁语副词 semper 源自拉丁语 semper。

原文: A sentiment can be expressed verbally by the choice of adjectives or adverbs, such as “(un)fortunately” and “regrettably”.
译文: 情感既可通过形容词或副词的选择进行语言表达，例如“幸运的是／不幸的是”与“遗憾地”。

原文: the language the lemma is translated to, principally represented in the <Translation> element.
译文: 即词目被翻译成的语言，主要通过 <Translation> 元素表示。
